examples.B1: The scholarship covers his tuition fees.
examples.B2: She applied for a sports scholarship at the university.
examples.C1: The professor was renowned for his impeccable scholarship.
examples.C2: This book represents a significant contribution to biblical scholarship.

seed.explanation_ar: منحة دراسية.. فلوس بتدفع للطالب المتفوق عشان يكمل تعليمه.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Scholar' 'طالب علم'.. الـ 'Scholarship' هي الفلوس اللي بياخدها الـ 'Scholar' عشان يدرس.
seed.usage_note: Can also mean 'academic knowledge' (e.g., 'a work of great scholarship').

seed.definition_en: To completely remove or get rid of something.

examples.A2: We must eliminate the error.
examples.B1: Doctors want to eliminate the disease.
examples.B2: The team was eliminated in the semi-finals.
examples.C1: The company plans to eliminate 200 jobs.
examples.C2: You can never completely eliminate risk from investment.

seed.explanation_ar: تتخلص من حاجة تماماً، أو تستبعد حد من مسابقة.
seed.mnemonic: شبه 'Limit' 'حد'.. 'Eliminate' يعني تنهي الحدود وتتخلص من المشكلة خالص.
seed.usage_note: Common in sports (eliminated from the cup) and problem solving.

seed.definition_en: A general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.

examples.A2: The price went up because of inflation.
examples.B1: The government is trying to control inflation.
examples.B2: High inflation reduces the value of savings.
examples.C1: Inflationary pressures are affecting the global market.
examples.C2: Hyperinflation rendered the currency practically worthless.

seed.explanation_ar: لما الأسعار بتزيد وقيمة الفلوس بتقل، ده اللي بنسميه التضخم الاقتصادي.
seed.mnemonic: زي ما بتعمل 'Inflate' 'تنفخ' البالونة وتكبر.. الـ 'Inflation' هو إن الأسعار بتكبر وتتضخم.
seed.usage_note: Can also refer to physically filling something with air (e.g., a balloon), but B2 context is usually economic.

seed.definition_en: A person who is the same age or has the same social position or abilities as you.

examples.A1: He is my peer at school.
examples.A2: She wants to be liked by her peers.
examples.B1: Children often learn a lot from their peer group.
examples.B2: The article was subject to peer review before publication.
examples.C1: He was respected by his peers in the scientific community.
examples.C2: The peerage system in Britain is quite complex.

seed.explanation_ar: الشخص اللي زيك بالظبط، سواء في السن أو المقام أو الشغل. يعني زميلك أو نظيرك.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Peer' قريبة من 'Pair' 'زوج'.. يعني انتوا اتنين زي بعض بالظبط.
seed.usage_note: Often used in contexts like 'peer pressure' or 'peer review'.

seed.definition_en: To shape or force into a curve; to incline the body downward.

examples.A2: Can you bend this wire?
examples.B1: He bent down to pick up the coin.
examples.B2: The trees were bending in the wind.
examples.C1: They refused to bend to the terrorists' demands.
examples.C2: He tried to bend the rules to suit his purpose.

seed.explanation_ar: إنك تتني حاجة وتخليها مقوسة، أو إنك تميل جسمك لتحت.
seed.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Band'.. زي ما الـ 'Band' 'الرباط' ممكن تعمل له 'Bend' 'تثنيه'.
seed.usage_note: Irregular verb: bend, bent, bent.

seed.definition_en: Two slices of bread with food like cheese or meat between them.

examples.A2: She made a cheese sandwich.
examples.B1: Can I have a ham sandwich?
examples.B2: We stopped for a quick sandwich.
examples.C1: I was sandwiched between two large men on the bus.
examples.C2: The sandwich generation cares for both children and aging parents.

seed.explanation_ar: السندوتش، عيش جواه جبنة أو لحمة أو أي أكل.
seed.mnemonic: هي هي بالعربي 'سندوتش'.
seed.usage_note: Named after the Earl of Sandwich.

seed.definition_en: A doctor who is qualified to perform surgery (operations).

examples.A1: The surgeon is in the hospital.
examples.A2: I want to be a surgeon when I grow up.
examples.B1: The surgeon washed his hands before the operation.
examples.B2: The heart surgeon performed a complex transplant.
examples.C1: She is a renowned neuro-surgeon at the teaching hospital.
examples.C2: The surgeon's dexterity was legendary in the medical community.

seed.explanation_ar: الدكتور المتخصص اللي بيعمل عمليات جراحية للمرضى.
seed.mnemonic: 'Surgeon' قريبة من 'Sir'.. هو 'Sir' في أوضة العمليات.. أو 'Surgeon' بيعمل 'Surgery'.
seed.usage_note: In the UK, surgeons are traditionally addressed as 'Mr/Ms' rather than 'Dr'.

seed.definition_en: The quality of being morally good.

examples.A2: Oh my goodness!
examples.B1: I trust in his goodness.
examples.B2: The vegetables are full of natural goodness.
examples.C1: She did it out of the goodness of her heart.
examples.C2: Philosophers have debated the inherent goodness of mankind for centuries.

seed.explanation_ar: الطيبة والخير اللي في الشخص، أو الجودة اللي في الشيء.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Good'.. الـ 'Goodness' هو الخير نفسه.
seed.usage_note: Also used as an exclamation: 'Oh my goodness!'

seed.definition_en: The showing of politeness in one's attitude and behavior toward others.

examples.A2: Saying 'thank you' is a courtesy.
examples.B1: They treated us with great courtesy.
examples.B2: It's common courtesy to hold the door for someone.
examples.C1: He answered the questions with unfailing courtesy.
examples.C2: The hotel provides a courtesy car for guests.

seed.explanation_ar: كياسة وذوق.. تصرف مهذب ولطيف مع الناس.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Court' 'بلاط ملكي'.. الـ 'Courtesy' هي أخلاق الملوك والنبلاء في التعامل.
seed.usage_note: Also means 'free of charge' (e.g., courtesy bus).

seed.definition_en: Not so great or important as the other or the rest.

examples.A2: Not used in A2.
examples.B1: A lesser man would have given up.
examples.B2: They traveled to lesser known islands.
examples.C1: We chose the lesser of two evils.
examples.C2: The charge was reduced to a lesser offense.

seed.explanation_ar: الأقل أو الأصغر في الأهمية أو الحجم مقارنة بحاجة تانية.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Less' 'أقل'.
seed.usage_note: Often used in 'the lesser of two evils'.

seed.definition_en: Relevant or appropriate to a particular situation.

examples.A2: Fill in the form where applicable.
examples.B1: The discount is applicable to students only.
examples.B2: These laws are not applicable in this country.
examples.C1: The theory is applicable to many different fields.
examples.C2: The clause is deemed applicable under international maritime law.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة تنفع تتطبق أو مناسبة للموقف ده.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Apply' 'يطبق'.. الـ 'Applicable' هو اللي قابل للتطبيق.
seed.usage_note: Often used in forms: 'if applicable'.

seed.definition_en: A thing with distinct and independent existence.

examples.A2: Not used in A2.
examples.B1: The two companies are separate entities.
examples.B2: The soul is considered a spiritual entity.
examples.C1: The corporation is a legal entity distinct from its owners.
examples.C2: Political geography treats the state as a sovereign entity.

seed.explanation_ar: كيان مستقل، زي شركة أو مؤسسة أو دولة، ليها وجودها الخاص المنفصل.
seed.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Identity' 'هوية'.. الـ 'Entity' لازم يكون ليه هوية مستقلة.
seed.usage_note: Often used in business and legal contexts (legal entity).

seed.definition_en: A long, narrow raised part of a surface, especially a high edge of a hill.

examples.A1: The mountain has a high top.
examples.A2: We walked along the top of the hill.
examples.B1: The path follows the ridge of the mountains.
examples.B2: You can see the ocean from the ridge.
examples.C1: The climbers traversed the narrow ridge carefully.
examples.C2: The geological formation features a prominent limestone ridge running north to south.

seed.explanation_ar: حافة طويلة وضيقة ومرتفعة، غالباً بتكون قمة سلسلة جبال.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Ridge' شبه 'Bridge' 'كوبري'.. تخيل الـ 'Ridge' كأنه كوبري طبيعي عالي بين الجبال.
seed.usage_note: Can refer to mountains (geography) or small raised lines on objects (e.g., fingerprints).

seed.definition_en: To change the form, character, or function of something.

examples.A1: Can we change this sofa into a bed?
examples.A2: I need to change my dollars to euros.
examples.B1: You can convert the file to PDF.
examples.B2: They converted the old warehouse into luxury apartments.
examples.C1: The solar cells convert sunlight directly into electricity.
examples.C2: He attempted to convert his critics with a persuasive speech.

seed.explanation_ar: يغيّر حاجة من شكل لشكل، زي تحويل العملة، أو تحويل ملف PDF لـ Word، أو تغيير الدين.
seed.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Cover'.. لما تعمل 'Convert' لحاجة، كأنك بتغير الـ 'Cover' والشكل الخارجي والمضمون.
seed.usage_note: Stress on the second syllable (con-VERT).

seed.definition_en: A musical instrument played by hitting with sticks or hands, or a cylindrical container.

examples.A2: I can hear a drum beat.
examples.B1: They stored the oil in a large metal drum.
examples.B2: The drummer hit the bass drum loudly.
examples.C1: He drummed his fingers on the table impatiently.
examples.C2: The constant drum of propaganda influenced the public.

seed.explanation_ar: آلة موسيقية 'طبلة' بتخبط عليها عشان تطلع إيقاع، أو برميل كبير أسطواني الشكل.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Drum' صوتها زي الخبط على الطبلة.. درم درم.
seed.usage_note: Can refer to the instrument, a container (oil drum), or the ear part (eardrum).

seed.definition_en: Strong determination to do something.

examples.A2: She showed strong will.
examples.B1: I admire your resolve to finish the job.
examples.B2: The difficulty of the task tested his resolve.
examples.C1: Her resolve weakened after the bad news.
examples.C2: They defended their position with unwavering resolve.

seed.explanation_ar: العزيمة والإصرار القوي إنك تعمل حاجة وماتتراجعش عنها.
seed.mnemonic: زي 'Solve' 'يحل'.. الـ 'Resolve' هو الإصرار اللي بيخليك تلاقي حل لأي مشكلة.
seed.usage_note: As a noun, it means determination. As a verb, it means to solve.

seed.definition_en: Violent, uncontrollable anger.

examples.A2: Her face turned red with rage.
examples.B1: Road rage is a serious problem.
examples.B2: He flew into a rage when he saw the damage.
examples.C1: The storm raged for three days.
examples.C2: His speech was fueled by a righteous rage against injustice.

seed.explanation_ar: الغضب الشديد جداً اللي الواحد بيفقد فيه السيطرة على أعصابه.
seed.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Red' 'أحمر'.. لما الواحد يبقى في حالة 'Rage' وشه بيحمر من الغضب
seed.usage_note: Also used in 'road rage' or 'all the rage' (very popular).

seed.definition_en: The legal state of being unable to pay outstanding debts.

examples.A1: The shop has no money left.
examples.A2: He lost his money and faced bankruptcy.
examples.B1: The company declared bankruptcy last year.
examples.B2: Many small businesses face bankruptcy during a recession.
examples.C1: The moral bankruptcy of the regime was evident to all.
examples.C2: They filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy to restructure their debts.

seed.explanation_ar: حالة قانونية لما الشخص أو الشركة مايقدروش يسددوا ديونهم، يعني 'فلّسوا' رسميًا.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bank' 'بنك' و 'Rupt' زي 'Rupture' 'تمزق/كسر'.. يعني علاقتك بالبنك انكسرت وماعدش معاك فلوس.
seed.usage_note: Can be used literally (money) or figuratively (moral bankruptcy).

seed.definition_en: To turn into ice; to stop moving suddenly.

examples.A2: It's freezing outside.
examples.B1: You can freeze the leftover food.
examples.B2: The police shouted, 'Freeze!'
examples.C1: Fear made him freeze in his tracks.
examples.C2: The bank decided to freeze the account due to suspicious activity.

seed.explanation_ar: المية تتحول لتلج، أو تثبت مكانك وماتتحركش خالص.
seed.usage_note: Irregular verb: freeze / froze / frozen.

seed.definition_en: Having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's own importance.

examples.A2: She is very humble.
examples.B1: Despite his success, he remained humble.
examples.B2: He came from a humble background.
examples.C1: In my humble opinion, this is the best option.
examples.C2: The humble abode belied the immense wealth of its owner.

seed.explanation_ar: شخص متواضع، مش شايف نفسه على الناس، وبسيط في تعامله.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Humble' قريبة من 'Human' 'إنسان'.. الإنسان لازم يكون 'Humble' ومتواضع.
seed.usage_note: Can also mean 'low in rank' (humble background).

seed.definition_en: The front part of the human body below the chest, containing the stomach and bowels.

examples.A2: The baby was sleeping on its belly.
examples.B1: He has a bit of a pot belly from drinking too much beer.
examples.B2: The plane landed on its belly.
examples.C1: They laughed deep in their bellies.
examples.C2: The underbelly of the city is full of crime.

seed.explanation_ar: يعني البطن أو الكرش. كلمة عامية شوية وبسيطة عن كلمة 'Stomach'.
seed.mnemonic: الـ 'Belly' يعني البطن.. افتكر الراجل اللي عنده 'Belly' كبير شبه الـ 'Bell' 'الجرس'.
seed.usage_note: Informal compared to 'abdomen' or 'stomach'. Can refer to the underside of an animal.

seed.definition_en: Having great influence on someone or something; powerful and effective.

examples.A2: TV is very influential.
examples.B1: She became an influential figure in the company.
examples.B2: His book was very influential in the 1990s.
examples.C1: They are the most influential group in the parliament.
examples.C2: The philosopher's influential treatise changed modern thought.

seed.explanation_ar: مؤثر، يعني شخص أو شيء عنده قوة وقدرة إنه يغير في آراء الناس أو الأحداث.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Influence' 'تأثير'.. الشخص الـ 'Influential' هو اللي كلمته مسموعة.
seed.usage_note: Describes people with power or ideas that change things (e.g., influential writer, influential theory).

seed.definition_en: Impossible to see.

examples.A2: Germs are invisible to the eye.
examples.B1: He felt invisible in the crowd.
examples.B2: The plane uses technology to be invisible to radar.
examples.C1: The invisible barrier between the two groups remained.
examples.C2: They discussed the concept of the 'invisible hand' in economics.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة مستحيل تشوفها بعينك، زي الهوا أو الأشباح.
seed.mnemonic: 'Visible' يعني متشاف.. 'In' بتنفي.. يبقى 'Invisible' مش متشاف.
seed.usage_note: Prefix 'in-' means not; opposite of visible.

seed.definition_en: One of the hard, white bony structures in the mouth used for biting.

examples.A2: He brushes every tooth carefully.
examples.B1: I need to go to the dentist to pull a tooth.
examples.B2: She has a sweet tooth and loves chocolate.
examples.C1: They fought tooth and nail to keep their home.
examples.C2: The law needs more teeth to be effective.

seed.explanation_ar: السِنّة، الحاجة البيضا الناشفة اللي في بوقنا وبناكل بيها.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Tooth' فيها حرفين 'oo' جنب بعض.. شبه شكل السنتين اللي جنب بعض.
seed.usage_note: Plural is 'teeth'. Irregular plural.

seed.definition_en: To keep animals for the purpose of producing young; to cause something to happen.

examples.A2: They breed horses on this farm.
examples.B1: Mosquitoes breed in stagnant water.
examples.B2: Poverty often breeds crime in urban areas.
examples.C1: Success breeds confidence.
examples.C2: His arrogance bred resentment among his colleagues.

seed.explanation_ar: إنك تربي حيوانات عشان تنتج منها سلالات جديدة، أو بمعنى يسبب ويولد مشاعر معينة.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Breed' قريبة من 'Bread' 'عيش'.. زي ما العيش بيخمر ويكتر، الـ 'Breed' يعني يتكاثر ويزيد.
seed.usage_note: Can be physical (animals) or metaphorical (familiarity breeds contempt).

seed.definition_en: A very large grey mammal with a long trunk, large ears, and two tusks.

examples.A2: Elephants have long trunks.
examples.B1: We saw a baby elephant at the zoo.
examples.B2: The African elephant is larger than the Asian one.
examples.C1: Poaching for ivory has endangered the elephant population.
examples.C2: The metaphorical 'elephant in the room' was ignored by everyone.

seed.explanation_ar: أضخم حيوان بيعيش على الأرض، لونه رمادي وعنده زلومة طويلة وودان كبيرة.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Elephant' أولها 'Ele'.. شبه 'عالي'.. هو حيوان عالي وضخم.
seed.usage_note: Symbol of memory ('an elephant never forgets').

seed.definition_en: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a circle or sphere.

examples.A2: Measure the width of the circle.
examples.B1: The diameter of the pipe is 10 cm.
examples.B2: You calculate the circumference using the diameter.
examples.C1: The asteroid has a diameter of five miles.
examples.C2: The lens aperture is expressed as a ratio of the focal length to the diameter.

seed.explanation_ar: القُطر. الخط اللي بيعدي في نص الدايرة بالظبط ويقسمها نصين.
seed.mnemonic: 'Meter' 'قياس'.. الـ 'Diameter' هو القياس اللي بيقسم الدائرة نصين 'Dia'
seed.usage_note: Don't confuse with 'radius' (half the diameter).

seed.definition_en: A woman on her wedding day or just before it.

examples.A2: The bride and groom cut the cake.
examples.B1: She was a nervous bride on her wedding day.
examples.B2: The bride wore a traditional white dress.
examples.C1: The magazine features the latest trends in bridal fashion.
examples.C2: Cultural expectations of a bride vary significantly across the world.

seed.explanation_ar: الست في يوم فرحها 'العروسة'.
seed.mnemonic: 'Bride' قريبة من 'Pride' 'فخر'.. العريس بيبقى عنده 'Pride' بعروسته الـ 'Bride'.
seed.usage_note: Contrast with 'groom' (the man). 'Bridal' is the adjective.

seed.definition_en: With reference to past events; in the past.

examples.A2: Historically, men worked outside.
examples.B1: The city is historically significant.
examples.B2: Historically, inflation has been much higher.
examples.C1: The region has historically been a center of trade.
examples.C2: Historically accurate costumes are essential for this period drama.

seed.explanation_ar: تاريخياً. يعني لما نتكلم عن حاجة حصلت زمان أو بحسب التاريخ.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'History' 'تاريخ'.. يعني بشكل تاريخي.
seed.usage_note: Used to describe trends over time or facts from the past.

seed.definition_en: A small to medium-sized primate that typically has a long tail.

examples.A2: I saw a monkey at the zoo.
examples.B1: Monkeys can climb trees very fast.
examples.B2: Stop acting like a monkey!
examples.C1: The research involved studying the behavior of rhesus monkeys.
examples.C2: He decided to stop monkeying around and get to work.

seed.explanation_ar: قرد.. حيوان ذكي بيعيش في الشجر وبيحب الموز.
seed.usage_note: Informally used to call a mischievous child.

seed.definition_en: The quality of being outstanding or extremely good.

examples.A2: She won a prize for excellence.
examples.B1: The school is known for its academic excellence.
examples.B2: They strive for excellence in customer service.
examples.C1: The award recognizes excellence in journalism.
examples.C2: Her pursuit of technical excellence made her a leader in the field.

seed.explanation_ar: الامتياز والبراعة، إن الحاجة تكون معمولة بأعلى جودة ومفيش زيها.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Excel'.. يعني يتفوق.. الـ 'Excellence' هو التفوق نفسه.
seed.usage_note: Often used in awards (Center of Excellence).

seed.definition_en: Wretchedly unhappy or uncomfortable.

examples.A2: The weather was cold and miserable.
examples.B1: He looked miserable sitting in the rain.
examples.B2: She has been making his life miserable.
examples.C1: The refugees were living in miserable conditions.
examples.C2: It was a miserable failure that cost the company millions.

seed.explanation_ar: بائس أو تعيس جداً. حالته صعبة وحزين أوي.
seed.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Misery' 'بؤس'.. وشبه 'Bues' في رواية 'Les Misérables' 'البؤساء'
seed.usage_note: Can describe a person (unhappy) or a situation (unpleasant, like weather).

seed.definition_en: The action or process of identifying the presence of something concealed.

examples.A2: The detection of the problem was fast.
examples.B1: Smoke detection systems are important.
examples.B2: Early detection of cancer saves lives.
examples.C1: The thief avoided detection by wearing a disguise.
examples.C2: Advanced algorithms allow for the detection of minute anomalies.

seed.explanation_ar: عملية اكتشاف حاجة كانت مستخبية أو مش واضحة، زي كشف الجريمة أو كشف المرض.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Detective' 'مخبر'.. شغلته الـ 'Detection'.
seed.usage_note: Common in 'early detection' (medicine) or 'crime detection'.

seed.definition_en: Of greater age; older (used especially of two family members).

examples.A2: Respect your elders.
examples.B1: The elder of the two sisters is a doctor.
examples.B2: He is an elder statesman in the party.
examples.C1: The council of elders met to discuss the issue.
examples.C2: Pliny the Elder was a famous Roman author.

seed.explanation_ar: الأكبر في السن، وغالباً بتتقال على الأخوات أو الناس اللي ليهم احترامهم.
seed.mnemonic: شبه 'Old'.. بس للأشخاص بنقول 'Elder' عشان الاحترام.
seed.usage_note: Used attributively (elder brother) vs 'older' (predicative). Also a noun (church elder).

seed.definition_en: Allowing a two-way flow of information between a computer and a user.

examples.A2: It is an interactive map.
examples.B1: The museum has interactive displays.
examples.B2: Interactive teaching methods help students learn.
examples.C1: The software provides an interactive user interface.
examples.C2: Highly interactive environments can increase user engagement significantly.

seed.explanation_ar: تفاعلي، يعني مش بس تتفرج، لأ ده انت بتدوس وهو بيرد عليك، زي الألعاب أو الشاشات اللمس.
seed.mnemonic: 'Inter' 'بين' + 'Act' 'فعل'.. فعل مشترك بين طرفين.
seed.usage_note: Common in 'interactive whiteboard', 'interactive map'.

seed.definition_en: A small animal with long ears and soft fur that lives in a hole in the ground.

examples.A2: I have a pet rabbit.
examples.B1: The magician pulled a rabbit out of the hat.
examples.B2: Wild rabbits can damage crops.
examples.C1: He rabbited on about his problems (slang).
examples.C2: The dog chased the rabbit into its burrow.

seed.explanation_ar: الأرنب، الحيوان المعروف بودانه الطويلة والفرو الناعم.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Rabbit' قريبة من 'Robot'.. تخيل 'Robot' على شكل أرنب.
seed.usage_note: Often kept as pets or found in the wild.

seed.definition_en: A person who has changed their religious faith or other beliefs.

examples.A1: He is a new member of the group.
examples.A2: She joined the club as a new member.
examples.B1: The group welcomes new converts warmly.
examples.B2: He is a recent convert to vegetarianism.
examples.C1: Recent converts are often the most zealous believers.

seed.definition_en: Capacity for sexual feelings; a person's sexual orientation.

seed.definition_en: Complete lack of inhibition or restraint.

examples.A2: (Noun usage rare at A2)

seed.definition_en: A person who judges the merits of literary, artistic, or musical works.

seed.definition_en: To find out how heavy something is.

seed.definition_en: A thin wooden stick with a black or colored center used for writing or drawing.

examples.B1: Sharpen your pencil before the test.
examples.B2: The sketch was drawn in pencil.
examples.C1: He penciled in a meeting for next Tuesday.
examples.C2: The graphite core of the pencil varies in hardness.

seed.definition_en: A person who gives advice, especially professionally.

examples.B1: I need to speak to an adviser.
examples.B2: She works as a legal adviser for the firm.
examples.C1: The president's special adviser resigned.
examples.C2: He acts as a technical adviser on the film set.

seed.explanation_ar: الشخص اللي بيدي نصايح، غالباً بيكون خبير أو مستشار في شغله.

seed.usage_note: Can be spelled 'adviser' or 'advisor'. Both are correct.

seed.definition_en: To state one's intention to take hostile action against someone.

examples.C2: Rising sea levels threaten the existence of island nations.

seed.usage_note: Followed by 'to' + infinitive (threaten to leave) or 'with' + noun (threaten with a gun).

seed.definition_en: To crush something into small particles; to rub surfaces together harshly.

examples.B1: Do not grind your teeth.
examples.B2: They grind the corn into flour.
examples.C1: The traffic ground to a halt.
examples.C2: He had an axe to grind with the administration.

seed.definition_en: Formed by the combination of many separate units; total.

seed.definition_en: A book or website listing individuals or organizations with details like names and addresses.

examples.C1: Please save the file in the root directory of the drive.
examples.C2: The alumni directory is a valuable resource for networking.

seed.explanation_ar: دليل أو قايمة فيها أسماء وعناوين وأرقام تليفونات مرتبة عشان تلاقي اللي بتدور عليه.
seed.mnemonic: من 'Direct' 'يوجه'.. الـ 'Directory' هو الدليل اللي بيوجهك لمكان أو رقم الشخص.

seed.definition_en: An association of people for mutual aid or the pursuit of a common goal.

seed.explanation_ar: جمعية أو نقابة كانت بتضم الحرفيين زمان 'زي النجارين أو الحدادين' عشان يحموا مصالحهم.

seed.usage_note: Historical context (medieval guilds) or modern gaming context (online guilds).

examples.C1: Serious consequences may arise from this decision.
examples.C2: A controversy arose regarding the interpretation of the law.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة تظهر أو تحصل فجأة، زي مشكلة أو فرصة.

seed.usage_note: Formal word. Often used with abstract nouns like 'problems', 'questions', 'needs'.

seed.definition_en: The state or fact of something being likely; probability.

examples.A2: There is a likelihood of rain.

examples.B2: In all likelihood, he will arrive tomorrow.
examples.C1: There is a strong likelihood that prices will rise.

seed.explanation_ar: الاحتمالية. يعني قد إيه ممكن الحاجة دي تحصل.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Likely' 'مُحتمل'.. الـ 'Likelihood' هي نسبة الاحتمال دي
seed.usage_note: Often followed by 'of' or 'that'.

seed.definition_en: A steady radiance of light or heat.

examples.A1: The fire has a warm glow.

examples.B2: The city lights cast an orange glow on the clouds.

examples.C2: The afterglow of the sunset lingered on the horizon.

seed.explanation_ar: ضوء خافت ودافئ طالع من حاجة سخنة أو منورة، زي الجمر أو الوش المحمر من الفرحة.
seed.mnemonic: زي 'Slow'.. النور بيطلع 'Slow' وهادي في الـ 'Glow'.
seed.usage_note: Can describe light, heat, or a person's healthy/happy appearance.

seed.definition_en: Respect and admiration, typically for a person.

seed.usage_note: Often found in phrases like 'hold in high esteem' or 'self-esteem'.

seed.usage_note: Often used in 'infant mortality' or 'mortality rate'.

examples.B1: He was sent into exile for ten years.

examples.C1: The government in exile continued to operate from abroad.
examples.C2: The psychological toll of forced exile is a common theme in his literature.

seed.explanation_ar: المنفى. إن حد ينطرد من بلده ومايقدرش يرجع لها تاني، غالباً لأسباب سياسية.
seed.mnemonic: شبه 'Exit' 'خروج'.. الـ 'Exile' هو خروج إجباري من البلد بلا عودة
seed.usage_note: Can be 'in exile' (state) or 'an exile' (person).

seed.definition_en: To move slowly and quietly to avoid being seen.

examples.A2: He crept into the room.
examples.B1: Mistakes began to creep into his work.
examples.B2: Old age creeps up on you.
examples.C1: Doubts began to creep in about the plan.
examples.C2: The ivy crept up the walls of the old house.

seed.explanation_ar: تتحرك ببطء وهدوء عشان محدش يشوفك أو يسمعك 'تتسحب'.
seed.mnemonic: زي الحرامي لما يعمل 'Creep' 'يتسحب' عشان يسرق.
seed.usage_note: Irregular verb: creep - crept - crept.

seed.definition_en: Free from pretense or deceit; proceeding from genuine feelings.

examples.A2: Thank you for your sincere help.
examples.B1: I would like to offer my sincere apologies.
examples.B2: She seems very sincere in her beliefs.
examples.C1: His apology was heartfelt and sincere.
examples.C2: Sincere gratitude is rare in this industry.

seed.explanation_ar: يعني صادق ومخلص.. مبيكدبش ومش بيمثل
seed.mnemonic: أصلها اللاتيني 'Sine Cera' يعني 'Without Wax'.. التمثال الأصلي مفيهوش شمع يخبي العيوب.. يبقى صادق
seed.usage_note: Common in letter endings ('Yours sincerely').

seed.definition_en: A strong feeling of pride in and devotion to one's country.

examples.A2: Nationalism is strong there.
examples.B1: The war increased feelings of nationalism.
examples.B2: Economic nationalism protects local industries.
examples.C1: The rise of extreme nationalism worries many leaders.
examples.C2: Nineteenth-century nationalism reshaped the map of Europe.

seed.explanation_ar: القومية أو الشعور القوي بالانتماء للوطن وتفضيل مصلحته على أي دولة تانية.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Nation' 'أمة/وطن'.. فالـ 'Nationalism' هي حب الأمة.
seed.usage_note: Can be positive (patriotism) or negative (belief in superiority).

seed.definition_en: Famous or well known, typically for some bad quality or deed.

examples.A2: That street is dangerous and notorious.
examples.B1: The city is notorious for its traffic jams.
examples.B2: He was a notorious criminal in the area.
examples.C1: The company is notorious for paying low wages.
examples.C2: The dictator was notorious for his suppression of free speech.

seed.explanation_ar: شخص أو مكان مشهور ومعروف، بس بحاجه وحشة أو سمعة مش تمام.
seed.mnemonic: عكس 'Glorious' مجيد.. هو مشهور بس بـ 'Notes' وملاحظات سلبية في ملفه.
seed.usage_note: Always negative. For positive fame, use 'famous' or 'renowned'.

seed.definition_en: Entirely; fully.

examples.A2: The story is wholly true.
examples.B1: I am wholly responsible for the mistake.
examples.B2: The two theories are wholly different.
examples.C1: It was a wholly inappropriate remark for the occasion.
examples.C2: The subsidiary is a wholly owned entity of the parent corporation.

seed.explanation_ar: بالكامل، يعني مية في المية من غير أي نقص.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Whole' 'كل'.. 'Wholly' يعني 'كلياً'.
seed.usage_note: More formal than 'completely' or 'totally'. Often used with adjectives like 'inappropriate', 'different', 'owned'.

seed.definition_en: An idea or theory on which a statement or action is based.

examples.A2: We started with a basic plan.
examples.B1: His argument is based on a false idea.
examples.B2: The whole movie is based on a strange premise.
examples.C1: The premise of the debate was that all people are equal.
examples.C2: If we accept the major premise, the conclusion follows inevitably.

seed.explanation_ar: فكرة أساسية أو فرضية بتبني عليها كلامك أو خطتك.
seed.mnemonic: قريبة من كلمة 'Promise' في النطق، بس المعنى مختلف.. الـ 'Premise' هو الوعد المنطقي اللي بتبني عليه النتيجة.
seed.usage_note: Often used in logic and arguments. Plural 'premises' can also mean a building/property.

seed.definition_en: A sum of money paid regularly by a company to its shareholders out of its profits.

examples.A2: Shareholders get a dividend.
examples.B1: The annual dividend was increased.
examples.B2: Investing in education pays dividends later.
examples.C1: The board declared a quarterly dividend of 50 cents.
examples.C2: His long training finally paid dividends when he won the gold medal.

seed.explanation_ar: جزء من أرباح الشركة بيتوزع على المساهمين كل فترة، أو الفايدة اللي بتعود عليك من حاجة عملتها.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Divide' 'يقسم'.. الأرباح اللي بتتقسم على الناس.
seed.usage_note: Can be literal (money) or metaphorical (hard work pays dividends).

seed.definition_en: A successful way of curing an illness or dealing with a problem.

examples.A2: Tea with honey is a home remedy.
examples.B1: We need to find a remedy for this mistake.
examples.B2: There is no simple remedy for unemployment.
examples.C1: Herbal remedies are becoming popular again.
examples.C2: The contract provides a legal remedy for breach of terms.

seed.explanation_ar: علاج لمرض أو حل لمشكلة بتواجهك.
seed.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Ramada'.. تخيل إنك رايح فندق رمادا كـ 'Remedy' 'علاج' للاستجمام.
seed.usage_note: Can be medical (herbal remedy) or legal (legal remedy).

seed.definition_en: A large boat with sails or a motor, used for racing or pleasure trips.

examples.A2: They went sailing on a yacht.
examples.B1: He bought a luxury yacht for his holiday.
examples.B2: The harbor was full of expensive yachts.
examples.C1: Owning a yacht is a symbol of immense wealth.
examples.C2: They chartered a private yacht to cruise the Mediterranean.

seed.explanation_ar: مركب كبير وفخم بيستخدم للفسح في البحر أو السباقات، وغالباً بيكون للأغنياء.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Yacht' قريبة من 'Hot'.. الجو 'Hot' وعايزين نركب الـ 'Yacht'.
seed.usage_note: Associated with luxury and wealth.

seed.definition_en: A fine open fabric of cotton or silk; also a cord used to tie shoes.

examples.A2: Tie your shoe lace.
examples.B1: The curtains are made of lace.
examples.B2: She wore a black lace veil.
examples.C1: The drink was laced with poison (verb usage).
examples.C2: Intricate lace patterns were popular in the 19th century.

seed.explanation_ar: قماش الدانتيل المزخرف، أو الرباط اللي بنربط بيه الجزمة.
seed.mnemonic: زي 'Necklace' 'عقد'.. الـ 'Lace' زينة زي العقد، أو رباط.
seed.usage_note: Context determines meaning (fabric vs. shoelace).

seed.definition_en: Relating to the gradual development of something.

examples.A2: Animals change slowly.
examples.B1: It is an evolutionary step.
examples.B2: Evolutionary changes take millions of years.
examples.C1: He studies evolutionary biology at the university.
examples.C2: The company adopted an evolutionary approach to software development.

seed.explanation_ar: تطوري.. متعلق بعملية التطور والتغيير التدريجي للكائنات أو الأشياء.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Evolution' 'تطور'.. حاجة ليها علاقة بالتطور عبر الزمن.
seed.usage_note: Common in biology (evolutionary biology) and general progress.

seed.definition_en: A small type of horse, often used for children to ride.

examples.A1: I want to ride a pony.
examples.A2: The pony is eating an apple.
examples.B1: She learned to ride on a small pony.
examples.B2: The children brushed the pony's hair gently.
examples.C1: Shetland ponies are known for their strength despite their size.
examples.C2: The equestrian center specializes in breeding pedigree ponies.

seed.explanation_ar: حصان حجمه صغير، مش مُهر 'ابن الحصان' لكن هو نوع سلالته كده قصيرة، ولطيف جداً مع الأطفال.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Pony' قريبة من 'Bonny'.. يعني جميل وصغير، أو افتكر تسريحة شعر 'Ponytail' 'ذيل الحصان'.
seed.usage_note: A pony is a specific breed of small horse, not just a baby horse (which is a 'foal').

seed.definition_en: Lack of fairness or justice; an unfair act.

examples.A2: He felt the injustice.
examples.B1: They fought against injustice.
examples.B2: It was a terrible injustice to put him in prison.
examples.C1: Social injustice is a major cause of unrest.
examples.C2: The novel exposes the gross injustices of the legal system.

seed.explanation_ar: الظلم، لما الحق يضيع أو حد يتعامل بطريقة مش عادلة.
seed.mnemonic: 'In' 'نفي' + 'Justice' 'عدالة'.. يعني مفيش عدالة.
seed.usage_note: Can be a general concept (social injustice) or a specific event (an injustice).

seed.definition_en: To experience something, especially a change or something unpleasant.

examples.A2: She must undergo surgery.
examples.B1: The company is undergoing major changes.
examples.B2: Athletes undergo intensive training.
examples.C1: The country is undergoing a political crisis.
examples.C2: The text has undergone significant revisions since the first draft.

seed.explanation_ar: لما تمر بتجربة صعبة أو عملية تغيير، زي عملية جراحية أو تدريب شاق.
seed.mnemonic: 'Under' 'تحت' + 'Go' 'يذهب'.. كأنك دخلت تحت التجربة ولازم تعديها وتخرج منها.
seed.usage_note: Usually followed by nouns like 'surgery', 'training', 'change'.

seed.definition_en: To run away quickly from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

examples.A2: The cat fled when the dog barked.
examples.B1: Many people had to flee the country.
examples.B2: The robbers tried to flee the scene.
examples.C1: Refugees were forced to flee their homes.
examples.C2: All rational thought seemed to flee his mind.

seed.explanation_ar: يعني يهرب بسرعة من خطر أو مكان مش آمن، زي الهروب من حريق أو حرب.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Flee' شبه كلمة 'Fly' 'يطير'.. لما تهرب من الخطر كأنك بتطير من السرعة.
seed.usage_note: Stronger and more urgent than just 'run away'. Often implies escaping danger.

seed.definition_en: Existing, occurring, or used under the surface of the sea.

examples.A1: Not used in A1 as adjective.
examples.A2: We saw a submarine movie.
examples.B1: Submarine cables carry the internet across oceans.
examples.B2: The volcano is submarine, located deep underwater.
examples.C1: Submarine warfare changed naval history.
examples.C2: They studied the submarine geology of the trench.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة موجودة أو بتحصل تحت سطح البحر.
seed.mnemonic: 'Sub' 'تحت' + 'Marine' 'بحري'.. يعني تحت البحر.
seed.usage_note: Most commonly used as a noun for the underwater ship, but 'adj' means underwater.

seed.definition_en: The cardinal number 18.

examples.C2: The manuscript dates back to the eighteenth century.

seed.usage_note: Commonly refers to age.

seed.usage_note: Can be a noun (the substance) or a verb (to stick).

seed.usage_note: Also means 'red in the face' (blushing). Context determines meaning.

seed.usage_note: Also used in psychology (projecting feelings onto others).

seed.definition_en: The player in sports like soccer whose job is to stop the ball from entering the goal.

seed.definition_en: Having or expressing devotion to and vigorous support for one's country.

seed.usage_note: Positive connotation mostly, but can imply nationalism.

examples.C1: The policy is inconsistent with our values.

seed.explanation_ar: يعني مش ثابت على مبدأ أو مستوى واحد، النهاردة برأي وبكرة برأي تاني، أو النتائج كل مرة شكل.

seed.usage_note: Often discussed in context of weight loss (fast/slow metabolism).

seed.definition_en: Something that absorbs shock or protects against impact; or temporary computer memory.

examples.B2: Savings can be a buffer against financial trouble.
examples.C1: The UN established a buffer zone between the two countries.
examples.C2: The chemical solution acts as a buffer to maintain pH levels.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة بتفصل بين شيئين عشان تقلل الصدمة أو التأثير، أو مساحة تخزين مؤقتة في الكمبيوتر.

seed.definition_en: An earlier event or action that is regarded as an example or guide for similar situations.

seed.definition_en: To explain or describe something clearly and exactly.

examples.C2: The will specifies how the estate should be divided.

seed.explanation_ar: تحدد حاجة بدقة ووضوح، وتقول تفاصيلها بالظبط.

seed.usage_note: Often used in contracts or instructions.

seed.definition_en: Differing in some respect from other forms of the same thing.

examples.A2: They use a variant spelling of the name.
examples.B1: The game is a variant of chess.
examples.B2: Scientists found a new variant of the virus.
examples.C1: The dialect is a regional variant of standard Spanish.
examples.C2: These myths are merely local variants of a universal theme.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة مختلفة شوية عن الأصل أو عن الباقيين، زي نسخة معدلة.

seed.usage_note: Common in biology (virus variant) and linguistics (spelling variant).

seed.definition_en: In which place, situation, or respect; in what way.

examples.B1: He showed me the clause wherein the rule is written.

seed.explanation_ar: كلمة رسمية معناها 'حيث' أو 'اللي فيه'. بتستخدم لما تشير لمكان أو وثيقة أو موقف وتقول إن جواه حصل كذا.

seed.usage_note: Archaic and Formal. Mostly found in legal documents or older literature. Equivalent to 'in which'.

seed.definition_en: A creeping or burrowing invertebrate animal with a long, slender soft body and no limbs.

seed.explanation_ar: كائن صغير وطويل ومالوش رجلين، بيعيش في الطين أو الأرض، وممكن نستخدمه طُعم للصيد.

seed.definition_en: A mark left on the skin where a wound, burn, or sore has not healed completely.

examples.B1: She has a scar on her knee from falling.
examples.B2: The surgery will leave a permanent scar.
examples.C1: The war left deep emotional scars on the survivors.

seed.explanation_ar: العلامة اللي بتفضل على الجلد بعد ما الجرح يخف.

seed.usage_note: Can be physical or emotional ('mental scars').

seed.definition_en: To add to something in a way that enhances or improves it.

examples.B1: This sauce complements the meat.
