examples.C1: We need a strategy that complements our existing policies.
examples.C2: The architectural style complements the surrounding landscape.

seed.explanation_ar: إنك تضيف لحاجة عشان تحسنها أو تكملها، زي لما تحط صوص على الأكل يكمل طعمه.
seed.mnemonic: نفس فكرة 'Complete'.. الفعل 'Complement' يعني 'بيعمل Complete'.
seed.usage_note: Different spelling from 'compliment' (praise). Check the 'e' in the middle.

seed.definition_en: The subjugation and assumption of control of a place or people by use of military force.

examples.A2: The conquest of the city took two months.
examples.B1: Stories of conquest and war are common in history.
examples.B2: The Spanish conquest of the Americas changed the world.
examples.C1: The conquest of inflation is the government's main goal.
examples.C2: His memoirs detail the military conquest of the entire region.

seed.explanation_ar: الغزو أو الفتح، لما جيش يسيطر على بلد تانية بالقوة، أو الانتصار في حاجة صعبة.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Quest' 'بحث/مهمة'.. الـ 'Conquest' هي المهمة الكبيرة للسيطرة على الأرض.
seed.usage_note: Historical context (The Norman Conquest). Can also mean a romantic seduction.

seed.definition_en: Overcome and take control of a place or people by use of military force.

examples.A2: The army conquered the city.
examples.B1: She worked hard to conquer her fear of spiders.
examples.B2: Scientists are trying to conquer the disease.
examples.C1: The Romans set out to conquer the known world.
examples.C2: He had to conquer his own demons before he could lead others.

seed.explanation_ar: تسيطر على بلد بالحرب، أو تتغلب على خوف أو مشكلة صعبة.
seed.mnemonic: شبه 'King'.. الـ 'King' هو اللي بيعمل 'Conquer' للممالك.
seed.usage_note: Can be physical (conquer a city) or metaphorical (conquer fear).

seed.definition_en: Existing or available in large quantities; plentiful.

examples.A1: There is a lot of food.
examples.A2: The garden has abundant flowers.
examples.B1: Fish are abundant in this lake.
examples.B2: We have an abundant supply of clean water.
examples.C1: The country is abundant in natural resources.
examples.C2: There is abundant evidence to support the theory.

seed.explanation_ar: موجود بكميات كبيرة جداً وكفاية وزيادة، زي الميه في المحيط.
seed.usage_note: More formal than 'plenty of'.

seed.definition_en: In a central or primary respect; essentially.

examples.A2: We are fundamentally different.
examples.B1: The system is fundamentally sound.
examples.B2: Fundamentally, I agree with you.
examples.C1: These two theories are fundamentally incompatible.
examples.C2: The discovery fundamentally altered our understanding of physics.

seed.explanation_ar: بشكل أساسي وجوهري، يعني في أصل الموضوع مش في القشور.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Fund' 'أساس' أو 'Fundamental'.. الأساس اللي بيتبني عليه كل حاجة.
seed.usage_note: Used to emphasize the most important part of a statement.

seed.definition_en: Decided or controlled by law.

examples.A2: Follow the rules.
examples.B1: You have legal rights.
examples.B2: The company met its statutory obligations.
examples.C1: There is a statutory requirement to report this.
examples.C2: Statutory interpretation is a key skill for lawyers.

seed.explanation_ar: قانوني أو تشريعي، يعني حاجة مفروضة بحكم القانون.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Statute' 'قانون تشريعي'.. 'Statutory' يعني حاجة تبع القانون ده.
seed.usage_note: Common in 'statutory rights' (rights you have by law).

seed.definition_en: To tie or fasten something tightly; to unite people or things.

examples.A2: They bind the books together.
examples.B1: Use a rope to bind the logs.
examples.B2: Shared experiences bind them together.
examples.C1: The contract binds the company to pay the fees.
examples.C2: Proteins bind to specific receptors on the cell surface.

seed.explanation_ar: يربط حاجة جامد، أو يجمع الناس مع بعض برابط قوي.
seed.mnemonic: زي ما تقول 'بند'.. العقد فيه 'بند' بيعمل 'Bind' 'بيلزم' الطرفين
seed.usage_note: Past tense is 'bound'.

seed.definition_en: An estimation of how much something is worth.

examples.A2: We need to know the value of the car.
examples.B1: The bank asked for a valuation of the house.
examples.B2: The company's valuation has increased this year.
examples.C1: They disagreed with the official valuation of the property.
examples.C2: Market volatility makes accurate asset valuation extremely difficult.

seed.explanation_ar: تثمين أو تقدير لسعر حاجة، زي لما خبير يقول البيت ده يسوى كام.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Value' 'قيمة'.. الـ 'Valuation' هو عملية تحديد القيمة دي.
seed.usage_note: Common in real estate and business contexts.

seed.definition_en: Concerning or enforcing discipline and punishment.

examples.A2: The school has strict rules.
examples.B1: He faced disciplinary action for being late.
examples.B2: The committee held a disciplinary hearing.
examples.C1: She was fired after a disciplinary procedure.
examples.C2: The regulatory body has broad disciplinary powers over its members.

seed.explanation_ar: تأديبي.. متعلق بفرض النظام أو العقاب لما حد يغلط.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Discipline' 'نظام'.. الإجراء الـ 'Disciplinary' بيتاخد عشان يفرض النظام.
seed.usage_note: Often used with 'action', 'hearing', or 'measure'.

seed.definition_en: The action of spending funds or the amount of money spent.

examples.A1: The shop tracks its daily money.
examples.A2: We need to reduce our spending on food.
examples.B1: The company is trying to limit its expenditure.
examples.B2: Public expenditure on education has increased this year.
examples.C1: The project requires a capital expenditure of one million dollars.
examples.C2: Cuts in government expenditure were necessary to balance the national budget.

seed.explanation_ar: كلمة رسمية شوية معناها الإنفاق أو المصاريف اللي بتطلع، خصوصاً للحكومات أو الشركات الكبيرة.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Spend' 'يصرف' و 'Expensive' 'غالي'.. الـ 'Expenditure' هي المصاريف الضخمة.
seed.usage_note: Formal term usually used in business, government, or economics contexts. Use 'spending' for daily contexts.

seed.definition_en: A sudden attack of illness, or the action of capturing something by force.

examples.A2: The police took the drugs.
examples.B1: The patient suffered a seizure.
examples.B2: The seizure of the ship caused tension.
examples.C1: Epileptic seizures can be controlled with medication.
examples.C2: The Fourth Amendment protects against unreasonable search and seizure.

seed.explanation_ar: ليها معنيين: نوبة مرضية 'زي الصرع'، أو مصادرة شيء بالقوة 'زي الشرطة لما تصادر مخدرات'
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Seize' يعني يمسك بقوة.. المرض 'Seizes' الجسم فجأة
seed.usage_note: Medical context (epilepsy) vs Legal context (property).

seed.definition_en: In a manner that is suitable or proper in the circumstances.

examples.A2: He didn't act appropriately.
examples.B1: She responded appropriately to the question.
examples.B2: You should dress appropriately for the interview.
examples.C1: The funds were not used appropriately.
examples.C2: The committee failed to deal appropriately with the conflict of interest.

seed.explanation_ar: إنك تعمل الحاجة بالشكل الصح والمناسب للموقف اللي إنت فيه.
seed.mnemonic: من 'Proper' مناسب.. اتصرف 'Appropriately' يعني خليك 'Proper' ومحترم.
seed.usage_note: Often modifies verbs like 'dress', 'act', 'respond'.

seed.definition_en: A written guarantee promising to repair or replace an article if necessary.

examples.A2: Is the phone under warranty?
examples.B1: The warranty covers repairs for one year.
examples.B2: I bought an extended warranty for my laptop.
examples.C1: The warranty is void if you open the device yourself.
examples.C2: Consumer laws imply a warranty of merchantability for most goods.

seed.explanation_ar: وعد مكتوب من الشركة إنها تصلحلك الجهاز أو تبدله لو باظ في فترة معينة 'الضمان'.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Warrant' يضمن.. دي ورقة الضمان اللي بتحفظ حقك.
seed.usage_note: Different from 'guarantee' (broader). Warranty is usually a specific legal contract.

seed.definition_en: A seat fastened on the back of a horse or other animal for riding.

examples.A2: He put the saddle on the pony.
examples.B1: My bicycle saddle is uncomfortable.
examples.B2: She adjusted the saddle before riding.
examples.C1: The cowboy spent days in the saddle.
examples.C2: He was saddled with debts he couldn't repay.

seed.explanation_ar: السرج. المقعد الجلد اللي بيتحط على ضهر الحصان عشان تركب عليه.
seed.mnemonic: 'Saddle' قريبة من 'Sit'.. هو المكان اللي بتعمل فيه 'Sit' على الحصان.
seed.usage_note: Also refers to the seat of a bicycle.

seed.definition_en: To commit oneself to and begin a task; to take on a responsibility.

examples.A2: He undertook the job.
examples.B1: Students undertake simple experiments.
examples.B2: The company undertook a major restructuring.
examples.C1: She undertook to finish the work by Friday.
examples.C2: The UN undertook a peacekeeping mission.

seed.explanation_ar: تتولى مسؤولية مهمة أو تبدأ في تنفيذ مشروع.
seed.mnemonic: أنت بتـ 'Take' 'تأخذ' المسؤولية 'Under' 'تحت' سيطرتك.
seed.usage_note: Formal word. 'Undertaker' is someone who prepares dead bodies (different meaning).

seed.definition_en: To become smaller in size or amount.

examples.A2: My sweater shrank in the wash.
examples.B1: The company's profits began to shrink.
examples.B2: Don't wash it in hot water or it will shrink.
examples.C1: She did not shrink from her responsibilities.
examples.C2: The market share continued to shrink despite their efforts.

seed.explanation_ar: إن الحاجة تصغر في الحجم، زي الهدوم لما تتغسل بمية سخنة وتكش.
seed.mnemonic: اربطها بصوت 'Sh' 'ش' في كلمة 'يكش'.. الـ 'Shrink' يعني يكش ويصغر.
seed.usage_note: Irregular verb: shrink - shrank - shrunk.

seed.definition_en: An instrument with a sharp blade or combination of blades, used to remove unwanted hair.

examples.A2: I bought a new razor.
examples.B1: Be careful, the razor is sharp.
examples.B2: He cut himself with the razor while shaving.
examples.C1: Occam's razor is a philosophical principle.
examples.C2: The debate was balanced on a razor's edge.

seed.explanation_ar: الموس أو الماكينة اللي بنستخدمها عشان نحلق الشعر.
seed.mnemonic: الـ 'Razor' بتعمل 'Raise' 'إزالة' للشعر من جدره.
seed.usage_note: Can be electric or manual (disposable).

seed.definition_en: A formal pledge or promise to do something; also a task or enterprise.

examples.A2: Not used in A2.
examples.B1: Moving house is a big undertaking.
examples.B2: He gave an undertaking to pay the money back.
examples.C1: The construction of the dam was a massive undertaking.
examples.C2: The court required a written undertaking from the defendant.

seed.explanation_ar: تعهد رسمي بإنك تعمل حاجة، أو مهمة كبيرة ومشروع ضخم محتاج مجهود.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Undertake' 'يتولى'.. كأنك بتاخد حاجة 'Under' 'تحت' مسئوليتك.
seed.usage_note: Can also refer to the funeral business (undertaker).

seed.definition_en: Financial support given by a sponsor to a person, organization, or activity.

examples.A2: We are looking for sponsorship.
examples.B1: The company offered sponsorship for the event.
examples.B2: They signed a lucrative sponsorship deal.
examples.C1: Corporate sponsorship is essential for the arts.
examples.C2: The ethics of tobacco sponsorship in sports have been widely debated.

seed.explanation_ar: الرعاية أو التمويل. لما شركة تدفع فلوس لحدث رياضي أو برنامج مقابل إن اسمها يظهر.
seed.mnemonic: الـ 'Sponsor' الراعي.. الـ 'Sponsorship' هي الرعاية نفسها
seed.usage_note: Common in sports and media.

seed.definition_en: A person engaged or learned in philosophy, especially as an academic discipline.

examples.A2: She wants to be a philosopher.
examples.B1: The philosopher wrote many books about life.
examples.B2: Greek philosophers asked questions about the universe.
examples.C1: As a moral philosopher, he debates ethics.
examples.C2: The philosopher's treatise challenged the prevailing ontological theories.

seed.explanation_ar: الفيلسوف، الشخص اللي بيفكر في أسئلة وجودية عميقة زي معنى الحياة والحقيقة.
seed.mnemonic: هي كلمة 'فيلسوف' بالعربي.. جاية من 'Philosophy' 'فلسفة'.
seed.usage_note: Derived from Greek 'lover of wisdom'.

seed.definition_en: A person who is sexually attracted to people of their own sex.

examples.A2: Some people are homosexual.
examples.B1: Discrimination against homosexual people is illegal here.
examples.B2: He came out as homosexual to his family.
examples.C1: The study explored the biological basis of homosexual behavior in animals.
examples.C2: Historical perspectives on the homosexual identity have shifted dramatically.

seed.explanation_ar: الشخص المثلي جنسياً. اللي بينجذب عاطفياً وجنسياً لأشخاص من نفس نوعه.
seed.mnemonic: 'Homo' باللاتيني يعني 'نفس' 'Same'.. و 'Sexual' جنسي.. يعني ينجذب لنفس الجنس.
seed.usage_note: Clinical/Formal term. 'Gay' is the more common, everyday term.

seed.definition_en: To express complete disapproval of; to sentence someone to a punishment.

examples.A2: The judge punished him.
examples.B1: We condemn violence.
examples.B2: The building was condemned as unsafe.
examples.C1: He was condemned to death for his crimes.
examples.C2: The film was condemned by religious groups for its controversial content.

seed.explanation_ar: إنك تعلن رفضك الشديد لتصرف معين وتستنكره، أو القاضي يحكم على حد بعقوبة 'زي الإعدام'.
seed.mnemonic: الكلمة فيها 'Damn' 'لعنة'.. كأنك بتلعن الفعل السيء ده وبتستنكره بشدة.
seed.usage_note: Often used in news (politicians condemn violence) or law (condemned to death).

seed.definition_en: To combine two or more things to form a whole; to become part of a group.

examples.A2: We work together.
examples.B1: The new student integrated well into the class.
examples.B2: We need to integrate the new software with the old system.
examples.C1: The policy aims to integrate immigrants into the community.
examples.C2: The architect integrated modern design with traditional materials.

seed.explanation_ar: إنك تدمج حاجات مع بعض عشان يعملوا نظام واحد متكامل، أو شخص يندمج في مجتمع جديد.
seed.mnemonic: افتكر 'Integer' 'رقم صحيح'.. بتجمع الكسور والأجزاء عشان تعمل واحد صحيح 'Integrated'.
seed.usage_note: Common in tech (integrate systems) and social contexts (integrate into society).

seed.definition_en: Make great efforts to achieve or obtain something.

examples.A2: We strive for better results.
examples.B1: They strive to improve the quality of life.
examples.B2: Companies strive to attract the best employees.
examples.C1: We must continually strive for perfection.
examples.C2: He strove against the political corruption of his time.

seed.explanation_ar: تبذل مجهود كبير جداً وتسعى بكل قوتك عشان تحقق هدف.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Strive' قريبة من 'Strife' 'كفاح/صراع'.. إنت بتكافح عشان توصل.
seed.usage_note: Followed by 'to' (strive to do) or 'for' (strive for success).

seed.definition_en: Not conforming to, permitted by, or recognized by law or rules.

examples.A2: Stealing is unlawful.
examples.B1: The police stopped the unlawful gathering.
examples.B2: He was accused of unlawful conduct.
examples.C1: The court declared the dismissal unlawful.
examples.C2: Unlawful detention of suspects raises serious human rights concerns.

seed.explanation_ar: أي تصرف ضد القانون ومخالف للقواعد المسموح بيها.
seed.mnemonic: 'Un' نفي + 'Law' قانون.. يعني تصرف عكس القانون.
seed.usage_note: Similar to 'illegal' but often used in formal legal contexts (e.g., 'unlawful assembly').

seed.definition_en: A general proposition proved by reasoning, especially in mathematics.

examples.A2: We learned a new theorem.
examples.B1: Pythagoras' theorem is famous in geometry.
examples.B2: She proved the theorem using logic.
examples.C1: The fundamental theorem of calculus connects differentiation and integration.
examples.C2: Fermat's Last Theorem remained unproven for centuries.

seed.explanation_ar: قاعدة رياضية أو علمية تم إثبات صحتها بالبرهان، زي نظرية فيثاغورس.
seed.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Theory' 'نظرية'.. الـ 'Theorem' هي النظرية اللي أثبتناها بالرياضيات.
seed.usage_note: A 'theory' is an explanation; a 'theorem' is a proven mathematical statement.

seed.definition_en: An official instruction or order given by someone in authority.

examples.A1: The boss gave a new order.
examples.A2: We must follow the safety directive.
examples.B1: The school issued a directive about uniforms.
examples.B2: The manager sent a directive to all staff regarding the new policy.
examples.C1: The European Union issued a directive on environmental protection.
examples.C2: Failure to comply with the presidential directive resulted in severe sanctions.

seed.explanation_ar: أمر رسمي أو تعليمات بتيجي من جهة مسؤولة عشان تقول للناس يعملوا إيه.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Direct' يعني يوجه.. الـ 'Directive' هو التوجيه الرسمي اللي بيوصلك.
seed.usage_note: Common in corporate, government, or EU contexts (e.g., 'EU Directive').

seed.definition_en: An action or strategy carefully planned to achieve a specific end.

examples.A2: We need a new tactic to win.
examples.B1: Using humor is a good tactic to reduce tension.
examples.B2: The manager changed his tactic halfway through the game.
examples.C1: Delaying the vote was a political tactic.
examples.C2: Their marketing tactics were aggressive but effective.

seed.explanation_ar: تكتيك أو خطة ذكية بتتعمل عشان توصل لهدف معين، زي في الكورة أو الحرب.
seed.mnemonic: نفس الكلمة بالعربي 'تكتيك'.. يعني خطة ملعوبة.
seed.usage_note: Tactics are the specific actions; 'strategy' is the overall long-term plan.

seed.definition_en: Feeling or causing despair; having no expectation of success.

examples.A2: I am bad at math (hopeless at).
examples.B1: He felt hopeless about the future.
examples.B2: It was a hopeless situation.
examples.C1: She gave a hopeless shrug of her shoulders.
examples.C2: The doctor admitted the patient's condition was clinically hopeless.

seed.explanation_ar: فاقد الأمل، أو حالة ميئوس منها ومفيش فايدة فيها.
seed.mnemonic: 'Hope' 'أمل' + 'Less' 'بدون'.. يعني مفيش أمل.
seed.usage_note: Can describe a person (feeling hopeless) or a situation (hopeless cause).

seed.definition_en: A long, narrow ditch.

examples.A2: Soldiers hid in the trench.
examples.B1: Workers dug a trench for the new pipes.
examples.B2: Life in the trenches was very hard.
examples.C1: The ocean trench is thousands of meters deep.
examples.C2: The political trench warfare continued for months.

seed.explanation_ar: حفرة طويلة وضيقة في الأرض، كانت بتستخدم زمان في الحروب عشان الجنود يستخبوا فيها.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Drench' يبلل.. الـ 'Trench' خندق وممكن يتملي مية وطين وقت المطر.
seed.usage_note: Associated with WWI ('trench warfare'). Also used in construction.

seed.definition_en: Extend over so as to cover partly.

examples.A1: The papers are on top of each other.
examples.A2: The roof tiles overlap to keep rain out.
examples.B1: My holiday overlaps with yours by two days.
examples.B2: There is some overlap between the two courses.
examples.C1: Their responsibilities overlap, causing confusion in the department.
examples.C2: The historical eras overlap, making precise dating difficult.

seed.explanation_ar: لما حاجتين يغطوا على بعض جزئياً، زي وقت الشغل لما يدخل في وقت الراحة.
seed.mnemonic: 'Over' فوق + 'Lap' حِجر.. كأن حاجة قعدت على 'Lap' التانية وغطتها.
seed.usage_note: Used for physical objects or abstract concepts (time, responsibilities).

seed.definition_en: Used to say that it does not matter which of the set is chosen.

examples.A2: Buy whichever you like.
examples.B1: Take whichever book you want to read.
examples.B2: Whichever way you go, it will take an hour.
examples.C1: Whichever decision you make, I will support you.
examples.C2: The prize will be awarded to whichever contestant scores highest.

seed.explanation_ar: أي واحد تختاره من المجموعة، مش فارقة انهي واحد.
seed.mnemonic: 'Which' 'أي' + 'Ever' 'مهما'.. يعني 'أي واحد مهما كان'.
seed.usage_note: Used as a determiner (whichever book) or pronoun (choose whichever).

seed.definition_en: A person living near or next door to the speaker or person referred to.

examples.A2: Our neighbours are very friendly.
examples.B1: I helped my neighbour carry her bags.
examples.B2: We're having a dispute with the neighbours about the fence.
examples.C1: Love thy neighbour as thyself.
examples.C2: The policy of good neighbourliness is essential for peace.

seed.explanation_ar: جارك اللي ساكن جنبك في البيت أو في الشارع.
seed.mnemonic: جارك 'Neighbour' ممكن يكون عنده حصان بيعمل صوت 'Neigh'.
seed.usage_note: British spelling (neighbour). American spelling (neighbor).

seed.definition_en: An act of assuming control of something, especially the buying of one company by another.

examples.A2: We heard about the company takeover.
examples.B1: The bank financed the takeover of the factory.
examples.B2: They launched a hostile takeover bid for their rival.
examples.C1: The military takeover resulted in a suspension of civil rights.
examples.C2: Corporate governance rules were tightened to prevent predatory takeovers.

seed.explanation_ar: لما شركة تشتري شركة تانية وتسيطر عليها، أو لما جيش يسيطر على مكان.
seed.mnemonic: هي كلمتين 'Take' 'يأخذ' و 'Over' 'فوق/على'.. يعني أخد السيطرة عليها بالكامل.
seed.usage_note: Common in business news (Hostile Takeover) and military contexts.

seed.definition_en: A soft white limestone used for writing on blackboards.

examples.A2: I wrote my name in chalk.
examples.B1: The chalk broke when I pressed too hard.
examples.B2: Gymnasts use chalk to keep their hands dry.
examples.C1: The cliffs of Dover are made of white chalk.
examples.C2: He chalked up his success to hard work and luck.

seed.explanation_ar: مادة بيضا طرية 'طباشير' كنا بنكتب بيها على السبورة زمان.
seed.mnemonic: بنكتب بالـ 'Chalk' وإحنا بنتمشى 'Walk'.. المدرس بيكتب ويتمشى في الفصل.
seed.usage_note: Also refers to the substance gymnasts use on their hands for grip.

seed.definition_en: Occurring only if specific circumstances exist; dependent on.

examples.A2: The plan is not certain.
examples.B1: Our success is contingent on your support.
examples.B2: The sale of the house is contingent on getting a loan.
examples.C1: The job offer is contingent upon passing a background check.
examples.C2: We must prepare for all contingent liabilities in the contract.

seed.explanation_ar: يعني حاجة مش أكيدة.. معتمدة على شرط تاني عشان تحصل
seed.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Contact'.. الحاجة دي 'Contingent' يعني لازم يحصل 'Contact' مع شرط معين عشان تحصل
seed.usage_note: Usually followed by 'on' or 'upon'. Noun form means a group of people.

seed.definition_en: A person responsible for managing money or property for others.

examples.A2: The bank acts as a trustee.
examples.B1: The board of trustees met yesterday.
examples.B2: She was appointed as a trustee of the charity.
examples.C1: The trustee has a fiduciary duty to the beneficiaries.
examples.C2: Legal disputes arose regarding the trustee's management of the estate assets.

seed.explanation_ar: الشخص الأمين أو الوصي اللي بيدير أموال أو ممتلكات نيابة عن حد تاني أو مؤسسة.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Trust' 'ثقة'.. الـ 'Trustee' هو الشخص اللي بنثق فيه يدير أموالنا.
seed.usage_note: Often found in 'Board of Trustees' for charities or universities.

seed.definition_en: An association, typically of several business companies.

examples.A2: A group of banks formed a team.
examples.B1: The project is funded by a consortium.
examples.B2: A consortium of investors bought the club.
examples.C1: The consortium won the bid to build the airport.
examples.C2: International consortia are often required for large-scale infrastructure projects.

seed.explanation_ar: مجموعة شركات أو بنوك متحدة مع بعض عشان ينفذوا مشروع كبير صعب شركة واحدة تعمله لوحدها.
seed.mnemonic: شبه 'Concert' حفلة.. بس دي حفلة 'Consortium' لرجال الأعمال والشركات الكبيرة.
seed.usage_note: Singular: Consortium, Plural: Consortia. Formal business term.

seed.definition_en: Relating to acting, actors, or the theater; exaggerated and excessively dramatic.

examples.A1: The play was in a theater.
examples.A2: She loves theatrical costumes.
examples.B1: He works for a theatrical company.
examples.B2: Her reaction was a bit theatrical and unnecessary.
examples.C1: The movie had a theatrical release before streaming.
examples.C2: His speech was marked by theatrical gestures and pauses.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة مبالغ فيها أو درامية زيادة عن اللزوم، زي تمثيل المسرح.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Theater' مسرح.. أي تصرف 'Theatrical' يعني تمثيل وأفورة.
seed.usage_note: Can describe a profession or behavior (drama queen).

seed.definition_en: A person who comments on events or on a text, especially on television or radio.

examples.A2: I like this sports commentator.
examples.B1: The commentator described the goal excitedly.
examples.B2: Political commentators analyzed the election results.
examples.C1: He works as a financial commentator for a news channel.
examples.C2: The commentator's biased remarks sparked a controversy.

seed.explanation_ar: المعلق، زي معلق الكورة اللي بيوصف الماتش، أو المحلل السياسي اللي بيشرح الأخبار.
seed.mnemonic: من 'Comment' 'تعليق'.. فالـ 'Commentator' هو اللي شغلته التعليق.
seed.usage_note: Specific types: 'sports commentator', 'political commentator'.

seed.definition_en: Taking place or progressing slowly or by degrees.

examples.A2: We saw a gradual change in the weather.
examples.B1: There has been a gradual improvement in his health.
examples.B2: The gradual decline of the empire took centuries.
examples.C1: She favored a gradual approach to reform rather than revolution.
examples.C2: The slope is so gradual that you hardly notice you are climbing.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة بتحصل شوية بشوية، ببطء وعلى مراحل، مش فجأة مرة واحدة.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Grade' 'درجة'.. يعني بتطلع درجة درجة، مش مرة واحدة.
seed.usage_note: Opposite of 'sudden'. Used for changes, improvements, or slopes.

seed.definition_en: The action or state of disregarding or ignoring something.

examples.A2: She showed disregard for my feelings.
examples.B1: His disregard for safety caused the accident.
examples.B2: They treated the law with total disregard.
examples.C1: The company showed a blatant disregard for environmental regulations.
examples.C2: Such reckless disregard for human life is unforgivable.

seed.explanation_ar: تطنش حاجة أو حد ومتعملوش اعتبار، كأنه مش موجود.
seed.mnemonic: 'Dis' نفي + 'Regard' احترام/اعتبار.. يعني قلة اعتبار وتطنيش.
seed.usage_note: Usually implies a negative or reckless ignoring of rules/safety.

seed.definition_en: To refuse to allow something; to order someone not to do something.

examples.A2: Smoking is forbidden here.
examples.B1: My parents forbid me from staying out late.
examples.B2: The law forbids the sale of alcohol to minors.
examples.C1: International treaties forbid the use of chemical weapons.
examples.C2: Strict social codes forbid such behavior in public.

seed.explanation_ar: يمنع أو يحرم حاجة بشكل قاطع، عكس يسمح.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'For-bid'.. تخيل إنك بتقول لحد 'لأ' على الـ 'Bid' 'العرض' بتاعه.. يعني بتمنعه.
seed.usage_note: Past tense is 'forbade', Participle is 'forbidden'.

seed.definition_en: Of little value or importance.

examples.A2: Don't worry about trivial details.
examples.B1: They argued over a trivial matter.
examples.B2: The problem seemed trivial at first.
examples.C1: Compared to the war, our problems are trivial.
examples.C2: We shouldn't get bogged down in trivialities while ignoring the core issue.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة تافهة أو بسيطة ومش مستاهلة اهتمام كبير.
seed.mnemonic: ألعاب الـ 'Trivia' بتسأل أسئلة 'Trivial' 'بسيطة/هامشية' للمتعة بس.
seed.usage_note: Don't confuse with 'jovial' (cheerful).

seed.definition_en: Perceptible by touch; clear and definite; real.

examples.A2: We need real results, not just talk.
examples.B1: There are no tangible benefits to this plan.
examples.B2: The police found tangible evidence at the scene.
examples.C1: We need to see tangible improvements in the economy.
examples.C2: The tension in the room was almost tangible.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة ملموسة وحقيقية تقدر تمسكها بإيدك أو تشوف نتايجها بعينك.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Touch' تلمس.. الـ 'Tangible' هو اللي قابل للـ 'Touch'.
seed.usage_note: Used for physical objects and clear evidence/results.

seed.definition_en: A thing that completes or brings to perfection.

examples.A2: The scarf is a nice complement to the dress.
examples.B1: Rice is a good complement to curry.
examples.B2: The team needs a full complement of players.
examples.C1: The wine was a perfect complement to the cheese.
examples.C2: In grammar, a subject complement follows a linking verb.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة بتكمل حاجة تانية وتخليها أحلى أو تامة، زي الطقم لما يكمل بعضه.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Complete' 'يكمل'.. الـ 'Complement' هو اللي بيعمل 'Complete' للصورة.
seed.usage_note: Not to be confused with 'compliment' (praise). Complement completes; Compliment praises.

seed.definition_en: Inspiring fear or respect through being impressively large, powerful, intense, or capable.

examples.A2: The mountain looked big and scary.
examples.B1: They faced a formidable enemy.
examples.B2: Completing the project was a formidable task.
examples.C1: She has a formidable reputation in the legal world.
examples.C2: The team overcame formidable obstacles to win the championship.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة قوية جداً وليها هيبة، بتخليك تحس بالخوف أو الاحترام، زي خصم قوي أو مهمة صعبة.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Formidable' فيها 'For' و 'Mid'.. تخيل 'Middle' الحلبة واقف فيها مصارع 'Formidable' مرعب.
seed.usage_note: Can be positive (respect) or negative (fear).

seed.definition_en: A position from which something is observed or considered; a point of view.

examples.A2: I see your point.
examples.B1: From my viewpoint, it was a mistake.
examples.B2: We need to consider the customer's viewpoint.
examples.C1: The novel is written from the viewpoint of a child.
examples.C2: Understanding diverse viewpoints is crucial for diplomacy.

seed.explanation_ar: وجهة نظر.. الطريقة اللي بتشوف بيها الأمور أو المكان اللي بتبص منه.
seed.mnemonic: 'View' 'منظر' + 'Point' 'نقطة'.. النقطة اللي بتشوف منها الموضوع.
seed.usage_note: Synonym for 'point of view' or 'perspective'.

seed.definition_en: The body of people allowed to vote in an election.

examples.A2: The voters are the electorate.
examples.B1: Candidates try to appeal to the electorate.
examples.B2: The electorate is unhappy with the current government.
examples.C1: A significant portion of the electorate remained undecided.
examples.C2: Demographic shifts have transformed the composition of the electorate over the last decade.

seed.explanation_ar: كل الناس اللي ليهم حق التصويت في الانتخابات في بلد أو منطقة معينة.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Election' انتخابات.. الـ 'Electorate' هما الناس اللي بيعملوا الانتخابات.
seed.usage_note: Refers to the group of voters as a whole entity.

seed.definition_en: An organization or person that lends money.

examples.A2: The bank is a lender.
examples.B1: You need to pay back the lender.
examples.B2: We found a lender for our new house mortgage.
examples.C1: The lender requires collateral for the loan.
examples.C2: Predatory lenders often target vulnerable communities with high interest rates.

seed.explanation_ar: الشخص أو البنك اللي بيسلفك فلوس وعادة بياخد عليها فوايد.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Lend' 'يسلف'.. الـ 'Lender' هو اللي بيسلف.
seed.usage_note: Common in finance: mortgage lender, money lender.

seed.definition_en: A man whose job is to sell products.

examples.A2: The salesman helped me.
examples.B1: A door-to-door salesman visited us.
examples.B2: He is a successful insurance salesman.
examples.C1: The salesman used persuasive techniques to close the deal.
examples.C2: Arthur Miller's 'Death of a Salesman' is a critique of the American Dream.

seed.explanation_ar: الشخص اللي شغلته يعرض عليك منتجات ويقنعك تشتريها.
seed.mnemonic: 'Sales' 'مبيعات' و 'Man' 'رجل'.. الراجل بتاع الـ 'Sales' اللي بيقنعك تشتري.
seed.usage_note: Specific to men. Use 'salesperson' for gender neutral.

seed.definition_en: Close familiarity or friendship; closeness.

examples.A2: The family has a lot of love and intimacy.
examples.B1: She felt a sense of intimacy with her new friend.
examples.B2: True intimacy requires trust and honesty.
examples.C1: The cozy room created an atmosphere of intimacy.
examples.C2: Their relationship lacked emotional intimacy despite their years together.

seed.explanation_ar: القرب الشديد والعلاقة الخاصة جداً بين شخصين، زي الصحاب القريبين أو المتجوزين.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Intimate'.. يعني 'إنت ميت' في دباديب اللي بتحبه.. دي قمة الـ 'Intimacy'.
seed.usage_note: Can refer to emotional closeness or physical/sexual closeness.

seed.definition_en: A difficult or annoying situation; also, something that binds or fastens.

examples.A2: I am in a difficult spot.
examples.B1: The glue acts as a bind for the wood.
examples.B2: His sudden departure put the team in a real bind.
examples.C1: We are in a bind because the funding was cut.
examples.C2: The legal double bind made it impossible for him to testify.

seed.explanation_ar: ورطة أو مأزق.. لما تكون في موقف صعب ومش عارف تتصرف. 'Informal: in a bind'.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bind' شبه 'بند'.. البند ده في العقد حطني في 'Bind' 'ورطة' كبيرة
seed.usage_note: Common idiom: 'in a bind' means in a difficult situation.

seed.definition_en: A fungal growth that typically takes the form of a domed cap on a stalk.

examples.A2: We picked a wild mushroom in the forest.
examples.B1: She added some sliced mushrooms to the pizza.
examples.B2: New cafes began to mushroom all over the city.
examples.C1: The atomic bomb created a massive mushroom cloud.
examples.C2: The town's population mushroomed after the discovery of oil.

seed.explanation_ar: نوع من الفطريات بيتاكل وشكله زي الشمسية، وممكن ينمو بسرعة جداً.
seed.mnemonic: الكلمة فيها 'Room' 'غرفة'.. شكل الـ 'Mushroom' عامل زي 'Room' صغيرة للكائنات الدقيقة.
seed.usage_note: Can be used metaphorically as a verb meaning 'to grow rapidly'.

seed.definition_en: To declare one's public approval or support of something or someone.

examples.A2: The boss agreed with the plan. (Simpler equivalent)
examples.B1: The newspaper decided to endorse the new policy.
examples.B2: Many celebrities endorse beauty products.
examples.C1: The committee refused to endorse the chairman's proposal.
examples.C2: The check must be endorsed on the back before it can be cashed.

seed.explanation_ar: إنك تعلن موافقتك ودعمك لحاجة أو لشخص بشكل رسمي وعلني.
seed.mnemonic: 'Endorse' فيها 'Door'.. كأنك بتفتح الـ 'Door' للفكرة دي وتسمح بيها، يعني بتأيدها.
seed.usage_note: Common in politics (endorsing a candidate) and advertising (celebrity endorsement).

seed.definition_en: To recognize or ascertain what makes someone or something different.

examples.A2: It is hard to differentiate the twins.
examples.B1: The brand tries to differentiate itself from competitors.
examples.B2: Color blindness makes it hard to differentiate red from green.
examples.C1: The law differentiates between intentional and accidental acts.
examples.C2: Cells differentiate into various specialized types during development.

seed.explanation_ar: إنك تعرف الفرق بين حاجتين أو أكتر، أو تخلي حاجة مميزة ومختلفة عن الباقي.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Different' 'مختلف'.. يعني بتشوف إيه اللي بيخلي الحاجة دي 'Different' عن غيرها.
seed.usage_note: Often followed by 'between X and Y' or 'X from Y'.

seed.definition_en: Based on observation or experience rather than theory or logic.

examples.A2: Science uses tests. (Simplified concept)
examples.B1: The results are based on real data.
examples.B2: There is no empirical evidence to support this claim.
examples.C1: His theory is supported by empirical research.
examples.C2: Empirical analysis often contradicts purely theoretical models.

seed.explanation_ar: تجريبي، يعني معتمد على التجربة والملاحظة الواقعية مش مجرد نظريات على الورق.
seed.mnemonic: شبه 'Empire'.. الإمبراطورية بتتبني على واقع وقوة 'Empirical' مش مجرد كلام نظري.
seed.usage_note: Common in science (empirical evidence).

seed.definition_en: Producing or capable of producing abundant vegetation or crops.

examples.A1: The land is good for plants.
examples.A2: Farmers like fertile soil.
examples.B1: The Nile Valley is very fertile.
examples.B2: They went to a doctor to check if they were fertile.
examples.C1: He has a fertile imagination for writing stories.
examples.C2: The 1920s provided a fertile ground for new artistic movements.

seed.explanation_ar: الأرض اللي بتطلع زرع كتير، أو الشخص القادر على الإنجاب.
seed.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Fruit'.. الأرض الـ 'Fertile' بتطلع 'Fruit' كتير.
seed.usage_note: Can be used for land, people/animals (reproduction), or imagination (fertile mind).

seed.definition_en: A strong feeling of disapproval or dislike, often caused by something unpleasant.

examples.A2: He looked at the trash with disgust.
examples.B1: She turned away in disgust.
examples.B2: His rude behavior filled me with disgust.
examples.C1: They expressed their disgust at the corruption scandal.
examples.C2: The sheer disgust he felt for his former partner was evident in his voice.

seed.explanation_ar: شعور بالقرف أو الاشمئزاز من حاجة وحشة أو ريحتها كريهة، أو حتى من تصرف سيء.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Gust' يعني ذوق 'زي Gusto'.. 'Dis-gust' يعني عكس الذوق، حاجة تقرف.
seed.usage_note: Can be physical (bad food) or moral (bad behavior).

seed.definition_en: Bitter indignation at having been treated unfairly.

examples.A2: She felt sad and angry.
examples.B1: He felt some resentment at being left out.
examples.B2: Her resentment towards her boss grew every day.
examples.C1: The decision caused deep resentment among the staff.
examples.C2: He harbored a lingering resentment over the way he was dismissed.

seed.explanation_ar: استياء أو مرارة.. شعور بالزعل المكتوم عشان حاسس إنك اتظلمت.
seed.mnemonic: 'Re' 'تاني' + 'Sent' 'أرسل'.. كأن المشاعر السلبية بتتبعتلك تاني وتاني فبتحس بـ 'Resentment'.
seed.usage_note: Often followed by 'against' or 'towards'.

seed.definition_en: A person who writes novels (long fiction books).

examples.A2: She wants to be a novelist.
examples.B1: The novelist wrote a famous book.
examples.B2: Many novelists struggle to get published.
examples.C1: The celebrated novelist won a literary prize.
examples.C2: His style as a novelist is characterized by intricate plotting.

seed.explanation_ar: الكاتب اللي بيألف روايات وقصص طويلة.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Novel' 'رواية'.. اللي بيكتب 'Novel' يبقى 'Novelist'.
seed.usage_note: Specifically for long fiction, not poets or journalists.

seed.definition_en: Moving forward in time or space.

examples.A2: We walked on.
examples.B1: From today onwards, I will exercise.
examples.B2: The agreement applies from June onwards.
examples.C1: They marched onwards despite the fatigue.
examples.C2: The records from the 18th century onwards are well preserved.

seed.explanation_ar: من الوقت ده وطالع، أو للأمام.
seed.mnemonic: فيها 'On' و 'Ward' 'اتجاه'.. يعني مكمل في الاتجاه ده 'Onwards'.
seed.usage_note: Often used with dates (e.g., from 1990 onwards).

seed.definition_en: The process of degrading or being degraded; deterioration.

examples.A1: The house is in a bad state.
examples.A2: Pollution causes damage to nature.
examples.B1: We must stop the degradation of our forests.
examples.B2: He felt a sense of degradation after losing his job.
examples.C1: Environmental degradation is a global crisis.
examples.C2: The prisoners suffered utter degradation and humiliation.

seed.explanation_ar: التدهور أو الانحطاط، لما قيمة حاجة تقل أو حالتها تسوء جداً.
seed.mnemonic: 'Grade' 'درجة'.. الـ 'De-gradation' هو إنك تنزل الـ 'Grade' 'الدرجة/المستوى' بتاع الحاجة.
seed.usage_note: Used for environment (soil degradation) or moral/social status.

seed.definition_en: Cause to be or remain alone or apart from others.

examples.A1: He is alone in the room.
examples.A2: Doctors isolate sick patients.
examples.B1: They tried to isolate the problem to fix it.
examples.B2: You should isolate yourself if you have the flu.
examples.C1: The political regime sought to isolate the country from international influence.
examples.C2: Scientists managed to isolate the specific gene responsible for the disease.

seed.explanation_ar: تفصل شخص أو حاجة عن الباقيين وتخليه لوحده.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Island' 'جزيرة'.. لما تعمل 'Isolate' لحد بتخليه كأنه عايش في 'Island' لوحده.
seed.usage_note: Common in medical contexts (quarantine) or social contexts.

seed.definition_en: Causing laughter and amusement; comic.

examples.A2: He told a humorous story.
examples.B1: She has a humorous way of speaking.
examples.B2: The movie takes a humorous look at family life.
examples.C1: His speech was both insightful and humorous.
examples.C2: The author is known for his humorous observations of daily life.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة تضحك أو دمها خفيف.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Humor' 'فكاهة'.. الشخص الـ 'Humorous' هو اللي عنده حس فكاهي.
seed.usage_note: More formal than 'funny'. Refers to the quality of humor.

seed.definition_en: An individual animal, plant, or single-celled life form.

examples.A2: Humans are organisms.
examples.B1: Bacteria are tiny organisms.
examples.B2: The pond is full of living organisms.
examples.C1: The social structure behaves like a living organism.
examples.C2: Genetically modified organisms (GMOs) are controversial.

seed.explanation_ar: الكائن الحي، سواء كان إنسان أو حيوان أو نبات أو حتى بكتيريا.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من كلمة 'Organ' 'عضو'.. لأن الكائن الحي مكون من أعضاء.
seed.usage_note: Scientific term used in biology.

seed.definition_en: A curved pointed horny nail on each digit of the foot in birds and some mammals.

examples.A1: The cat has a sharp claw.
examples.A2: The eagle grabbed the fish with its claw.
examples.B1: Be careful, the kitten might scratch you with a claw.
examples.B2: Crabs have a large claw for crushing food.
examples.C1: He fought his way back, clawing his way up the cliff.
examples.C2: The beast left deep claw marks on the wooden door.

seed.explanation_ar: مخلب الحيوان أو الطير، الضفر الحاد القوي اللي بيصطاد بيه.
seed.mnemonic: شكل الكلمة 'Claw' فيه حرف C و w زي شكل المخلب المعووج.
seed.usage_note: Can also be a verb 'to claw' (scratch).

seed.definition_en: Relating to geometry, or characterized by regular lines and shapes.

examples.A2: We learned about geometric shapes in school.
examples.B1: The building has a geometric design.
examples.B2: Islamic art is famous for its geometric patterns.
examples.C1: The artist uses bold geometric forms in his sculpture.
examples.C2: The population growth followed a geometric progression.

seed.explanation_ar: ليه علاقة بالأشكال الهندسية زي المربع والمثلث والخطوط المستقيمة.
seed.mnemonic: 'Geo' أرض + 'Metric' قياس.. الهندسة هي قياس الأرض والأشكال.
seed.usage_note: Used in math, art, and design.

seed.definition_en: The cardinal number 19.

examples.A2: There are nineteen students.
examples.B1: He scored nineteen points.
examples.B2: Nineteen people applied for the job.
examples.C1: Talk nineteen to the dozen (speak very fast).
examples.C2: The phenomenon was first observed in the nineteenth century.

seed.explanation_ar: العدد تسعة عشر.
seed.mnemonic: Nine + Teen.
seed.usage_note: Counting number.

seed.definition_en: A set of stairs and its surrounding structure.

examples.A2: The house has a wooden staircase.
examples.B1: She fell down the staircase.
examples.B2: A spiral staircase leads to the tower.
examples.C1: The grand staircase was the centerpiece of the mansion.
examples.C2: He descended the marble staircase with great dignity.

seed.explanation_ar: السلم بالدرابزين والهيكل بتاعه اللي بيوصل بين الأدوار.
seed.mnemonic: 'Stair' 'سلم' + 'Case' 'إطار'.. السلم بالهيكل المحيط بيه.
seed.usage_note: More specific than 'stairs', implying the whole structure.

seed.definition_en: A journalist who writes a regular article for a newspaper or magazine.

examples.A2: I read the columnist's article today.
examples.B1: The columnist writes about sports every week.
examples.B2: She works as a political columnist for a major daily newspaper.
examples.C1: The columnist's controversial views sparked a debate.
examples.C2: As a seasoned columnist, his insights influence public opinion significantly.

seed.explanation_ar: صحفي بيكتب مقال ثابت بشكل دوري في جريدة أو مجلة.
seed.mnemonic: هو الشخص اللي بيكتب في 'Column' 'عمود' في الجريدة.. فبنسميه 'Columnist'.
seed.usage_note: Specifically refers to someone with a recurring section (column), not just a reporter.

seed.definition_en: To cancel the effect of a previous action or to unfasten something.

examples.A2: Please undo your coat.
examples.B1: You can press the button to undo the last change.
examples.B2: It is difficult to undo the damage caused by the storm.
examples.C1: They tried to undo the effects of years of neglect.
examples.C2: History cannot be undone, but we can learn from it.

seed.explanation_ar: يعني ترجع في كلامك أو تلغي حاجة عملتها، أو تفك حاجة مربوطة زي زرار القميص.
seed.mnemonic: عكس 'Do' 'يفعل'.. لما تعمل حاجة وعايز ترجع فيها بتعمل 'Undo'.
seed.usage_note: Common in computing (undo typing) and clothing (undo buttons).

seed.definition_en: Based on feelings rather than facts or proof; easy to understand without instruction.

examples.A2: The game is easy and intuitive.
examples.B1: She has an intuitive understanding of animals.
examples.B2: The software is very intuitive to use.
examples.C1: He made an intuitive decision that saved the company.
examples.C2: Most people have an intuitive sense of right and wrong.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة بتفهمها بالإحساس أو بالبديهة من غير ما حد يشرحهالك، أو برنامج سهل الاستخدام.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Intuition' 'الحدس'.. يعني بتعتمد على إحساسك الداخلي.
seed.usage_note: Common in tech ('intuitive interface') and psychology.

seed.definition_en: Money given by a government or organization to keep prices low or help a business.

examples.A2: The government pays a subsidy.
examples.B1: The housing subsidy helps poor families.
examples.B2: They removed the subsidy on fuel.
examples.C1: The industry relies heavily on government subsidies.
examples.C2: Critics argue that the subsidy distorts market prices.

seed.explanation_ar: فلوس الحكومة بتدفعها عشان تدعم سلعة معينة 'زي العيش والبنزين' وتخلي سعرها رخيص للناس.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Sub' يعني 'فرعي' أو 'تحت'.. الـ 'Subsidy' دي مساعدة مالية بتسند السعر من 'تحت' عشان ميعلاش.
seed.usage_note: Often discussed in economics and politics (e.g., 'agricultural subsidies').

seed.definition_en: Existing or occurring at or on the surface; not deep or thorough.

examples.A2: It was a superficial cut.
examples.B1: He has a superficial knowledge of the topic.
examples.B2: Don't judge by superficial appearances.
examples.C1: The changes were purely superficial and didn't solve the problem.
examples.C2: His analysis was criticized for being superficial and lacking insight.

seed.explanation_ar: سطحي، يعني يا دوب من بره بس وما بيدخلش في العمق أو التفاصيل، سواء جرح سطحي أو شخص سطحي.
seed.mnemonic: 'Super' + 'Face'.. يعني حاجة على الـ 'Face' 'الوش' بس، مش جوه.
seed.usage_note: Can be physical (superficial wound) or personality (superficial person).

seed.definition_en: A person who brings a case against another in a court of law.

examples.A2: The man sued his boss.
examples.B1: The lawyer spoke for the accuser.
examples.B2: The plaintiff is asking for a lot of money.
examples.C1: The burden of proof lies with the plaintiff.
examples.C2: The plaintiff's counsel argued that the contract was breached.

seed.explanation_ar: الشخص اللي بيرفع قضية على حد تاني في المحكمة 'المدعي'.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Complain' 'يشتكي'.. الـ 'Plaintiff' هو اللي بيقدم الشكوى للمحكمة.
seed.usage_note: Opposite of 'defendant' (the person accused). Legal terminology.

seed.definition_en: A small part broken or separated off something.

examples.A2: He found a bone fragment.
examples.B1: The vase broke into fragments.
examples.B2: She heard only a fragment of the conversation.
examples.C1: Archaeologists found fragments of pottery.
examples.C2: The memory returned in fragmented, disjointed images.

seed.explanation_ar: حتة صغيرة مكسورة من حاجة أكبر، زي شظية قزاز أو حتة فخار مكسورة.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fragile' 'قابل للكسر' لما تقع وتتكسر بتبقى 'Fragments' 'شظايا'.
seed.usage_note: Can also be a verb (frag-MENT) meaning to break into pieces.

seed.definition_en: Importance requiring swift action.

examples.A2: There is no urgency, take your time.
examples.B1: I understood the urgency of the situation.
examples.B2: We need to act with a sense of urgency.
examples.C1: The urgency of the climate crisis cannot be overstated.
examples.C2: His voice lacked the urgency required to convince the crowd.

seed.explanation_ar: الاستعجال أو الضرورة القصوى.. لما يكون فيه حاجة لازم تتعمل حالاً وماتستناش.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Urgent' 'عاجل'.. جاية من 'Urge' 'يُلِح'.. الـ 'Urgency' هو الإلحاح والسرعة.
seed.usage_note: Often implies a crisis or pressure. 'Sense of urgency' is a common phrase.

seed.definition_en: The action of keeping away from or not doing something.

examples.A2: Avoidance of bad food is good.
examples.B1: His avoidance of the question was obvious.
examples.B2: Collision avoidance systems are now common in cars.
examples.C1: Tax avoidance is legal, but tax evasion is a crime.
examples.C2: Psychological avoidance of trauma can lead to long-term issues.

seed.explanation_ar: إنك تتجنب حاجة أو تبعد عنها.. زي تجنب المشاكل أو الضرايب
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Avoid' يعني يتجنب.. الـ 'Avoidance' هو التجنب نفسه
seed.usage_note: Common in 'tax avoidance' (legal) vs 'tax evasion' (illegal).

seed.definition_en: To express an idea or feeling fluently and coherently.

examples.A2: He can articulate his words well.
examples.B1: She struggled to articulate her feelings.
examples.B2: The teacher helped him articulate his thoughts.
examples.C1: He was able to articulate the complex theory simply.
examples.C2: The philosophy was never fully articulated by its founder.

seed.explanation_ar: إنك تعرف تعبر عن أفكارك وتتكلم بوضوح وطلاقة.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Art' 'فن'.. الـ 'Articulate' عنده فن الكلام.
seed.usage_note: Adjective form is pronounced /...lət/, Verb form is /...leɪt/.

seed.definition_en: To grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way.

examples.A2: The plant grows well here.
examples.B1: Business is starting to flourish.
examples.B2: The arts flourished during that period.
examples.C1: Under her leadership, the company flourished.
examples.C2: Bacteria flourish in warm, damp environments.

seed.explanation_ar: يزدهر وينمو بقوة.. لما مشروع أو زرعة تكبر وتنجح.
seed.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Flower' 'الوردة' لما تفتح وتكبر.. المشروع بيـ 'Flourish'.
seed.usage_note: Similar to 'thrive' or 'prosper'.

seed.definition_en: To make someone extremely annoyed or angry; to drive insane.

examples.A2: The noise maddens him.
examples.B1: It maddens me when people are late.
examples.B2: The slow internet connection was maddening.
examples.C1: The injustice of the situation maddened the crowd.
examples.C2: To be ignored completely is enough to madden anyone.

seed.explanation_ar: يعصب حد جداً ويطير عقله، أو يجننه.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Mad' 'مجنون'.. الـ 'Madden' هو الفعل، يعني يجنن حد.
seed.usage_note: Often used as an adjective 'maddening' (annoying).

seed.definition_en: To give all or a large part of one's time or resources to a person, activity, or cause.

examples.A2: She devotes her time to study.
examples.B1: He devoted his life to helping the poor.
examples.B2: They are devoted to each other.
examples.C1: The magazine devotes a section to fashion.
examples.C2: She devoted herself entirely to her research.

seed.explanation_ar: إنك تدي كل وقتك ومجهودك لحاجة معينة أو لشخص بتحبه، يعني تكرس حياتك ليه.
seed.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Vote' 'تصويت'.. كأنك بتدي صوتك وولائك كله للقضية دي.
seed.usage_note: Almost always used in the passive 'be devoted to' or reflexive 'devote oneself to'.

seed.definition_en: According to the customs or usual practices of a particular society.

examples.A2: It is usual for us.
examples.B1: It is customary to give gifts.
examples.B2: She offered the customary greeting.
examples.C1: It is customary for the bride's father to pay for the wedding.
examples.C2: The customary laws of the tribe were respected by the new government.

seed.explanation_ar: معتاد أو مألوف، حاجة الناس متعودة تعملها بحكم العادة والتقاليد.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Custom' 'عادة'.. فالـ 'Customary' هو اللي ماشي حسب العادة.
seed.usage_note: Similar to 'traditional' but implies a specific habit (It is customary to shake hands).

seed.definition_en: Occurring, operating, or done at the same time.

examples.A1: They arrived at the same time.
examples.A2: The two events were simultaneous.
examples.B1: There was a simultaneous applause from the crowd.
examples.B2: The software allows simultaneous access for multiple users.
examples.C1: Simultaneous interpretation is a very difficult skill.
examples.C2: The composer used simultaneous rhythms to create a chaotic effect.

seed.explanation_ar: متزامن. يعني حاجتين بيحصلوا مع بعض في نفس اللحظة بالظبط.
seed.mnemonic: 'Simul' في الأول زي 'Simulation' أو 'Similar'.. حاجات ماشية مع بعض في نفس الوقت.
seed.usage_note: Common in technology (simultaneous connection) and translation (simultaneous interpretation).

seed.definition_en: In an opposite way; used to introduce a statement that reverses the previous one.

examples.A2: Some people like hot weather; conversely, others prefer cold.
examples.B1: You can go by bus, or conversely, you can walk.
examples.B2: Poor health is accepted as a cause of poverty; conversely, poverty causes poor health.
examples.C1: American consumers prefer white eggs; conversely, British buyers like brown eggs.
examples.C2: If the tax is reduced, spending may rise; conversely, if interest rates go up, spending may fall.

seed.explanation_ar: كلمة بنستخدمها عشان نقول العكس. يعني لو قلت حاجة وعايز تقول عكسها تماماً.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Converse' يعني عكس. لما تقول حاجة و 'Conversely' تقول عكسها.
seed.usage_note: Used in formal writing to show contrast.

seed.definition_en: To confirm, support, or maintain a custom, law, or principle.

examples.A1: We must hold up the rules.
examples.A2: The school upholds good behavior.
examples.B1: They promised to uphold the traditions of the club.
examples.B2: The police officer swore to uphold the law.
examples.C1: The court upheld the previous decision.
examples.C2: It is the duty of the press to uphold freedom of speech.

seed.explanation_ar: إنك تدافع عن حاجة زي قانون أو مبدأ وتتأكد إن الناس بتحترمها وبتطبقها.
seed.mnemonic: 'Up' 'فوق' و 'Hold' 'يمسك'.. يعني تمسك الحاجة وترفعها لفوق عشان الكل يشوفها ويحترمها.
seed.usage_note: Often used in legal contexts (judges uphold a verdict).

seed.definition_en: A substance that plants, animals, and people need to live and grow.

examples.A1: Milk has good things for you.
examples.A2: Plants need nutrients from the soil.
examples.B1: Vegetables are full of essential nutrients.
examples.B2: A lack of nutrients can cause illness.
examples.C1: The soil is rich in organic nutrients.
examples.C2: Micro-nutrients are vital for metabolic processes.

seed.explanation_ar: المادة المغذية 'زي الفيتامينات والمعادن' اللي الجسم محتاجها عشان يكبر ويعيش.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Nutrition' 'تغذية'.. الـ 'Nutrient' هو العنصر اللي بيغذي.
seed.usage_note: Often plural (nutrients). Used in biology and health contexts.

seed.definition_en: To a moderate degree as compared to something else; relatively.

examples.A2: The test was not too hard compared to the last one.
examples.B1: The city is comparatively small.
examples.B2: Comparatively few people know the truth.
examples.C1: The disease is comparatively rare in this region.
examples.C2: Inflation has remained comparatively low despite the economic turmoil.

seed.explanation_ar: نسبياً أو بالمقارنة بغيره. يعني لما تقارن حاجة بحاجة تانية.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Compare' 'يقارن'.. يعني بتحكم على الحاجة بالمقارنة بغيرها
seed.usage_note: Often implies 'quite' or 'fairly' (comparatively easy).

seed.definition_en: A tool with a broad blade used for moving loose material like earth or snow.

examples.A2: He used a shovel to dig a hole.
examples.B1: We have to shovel the snow off the driveway.
examples.B2: The workers leaned on their shovels during the break.
examples.C1: They shoveled money into the failing project to no avail.
examples.C2: Archaeologists used a small shovel to carefully remove the sediment.

seed.explanation_ar: أداة ليها يد طويلة وسلاح عريض بنستخدمها عشان نشيل بيها التراب أو الرمل أو التلج 'الكوريك'.
seed.mnemonic: قريبة من كلمة 'Shove' 'يزق'.. لأنك بالـ 'Shovel' بتزق التراب وتشيله.
seed.usage_note: Can be a noun (the tool) or a verb (to use the tool).

seed.definition_en: To provide a person or place with the things that are needed.

examples.A2: We need to equip the kitchen.
examples.B1: The school is equipped with new computers.
examples.B2: They equipped the expedition with warm clothing.
examples.C1: The course aims to equip students with essential skills.
examples.C2: The vessel was fully equipped for deep-sea exploration.

seed.explanation_ar: يجهز أو يزود. تدي حد المعدات أو الأدوات اللي محتاجها لمهمة معينة.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Equipment' 'معدات'.. الفعل 'Equip' يعني تدي حد الـ 'Equipment'.
seed.usage_note: Often passive: 'be equipped with'.

seed.definition_en: A shaped mass of baked bread.

examples.A1: I bought a loaf of bread.
examples.A2: We need two loaves.
examples.B1: She sliced the loaf.
examples.B2: A fresh loaf smells wonderful.
examples.C1: Meatloaf is a dish shaped like a loaf.
examples.C2: He spent the afternoon loafing around the house.

seed.explanation_ar: رغيف العيش الكامل قبل ما يتقطع 'زي التوست أو الفينو'.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Loaf' شبه 'Life'.. والعيش هو الـ 'Life' 'الحياة' عند ناس كتير.
seed.usage_note: Plural is 'loaves'. Also a verb 'to loaf' meaning to be lazy.

seed.definition_en: A person who catches fish for a living or for sport.

examples.A2: The fisherman caught a big fish.
examples.B1: Fishermen go out to sea early in the morning.
examples.B2: The old fisherman mended his nets.
examples.C1: Local fishermen are protesting against pollution.
examples.C2: The livelihood of the coastal fishermen depends on sustainable practices.

seed.explanation_ar: الشخص اللي بيصطاد سمك، سواء كشغلانة أو هواية.
seed.mnemonic: 'Fish' 'سمك' + 'Man' 'رجل'.. رجل السمك 'الصياد'.
seed.usage_note: Plural is 'fishermen'. Gender-neutral term is 'fisher'.

seed.definition_en: A large, thick, flat piece of stone, concrete, or wood.

examples.A2: He sat on a slab of rock.
examples.B1: They poured a concrete slab for the patio.
examples.B2: She cut a thick slab of cake for him.
examples.C1: The bodies were laid out on cold stone slabs.
examples.C2: The tectonic slab movement caused the earthquake.

seed.explanation_ar: حتة كبيرة وتخينة ومسطحة من الحجر أو الخرسانة، زي بلاطة الرصيف بس ضخمة.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Slab' صوتها تقيل زي الحجر.. 'سْلاب' هبدة حجر على الأرض.
seed.usage_note: Can also refer to a thick slice of food (slab of chocolate/meat).

seed.definition_en: To hold on tightly to someone or something; to stick or adhere.

examples.A2: Wet clothes cling to the body.
examples.B1: He clung to the rope to save himself.
examples.B2: She clung to the hope that he was still alive.
examples.C1: The smell of smoke clung to his clothes.
examples.C2: Traditionalists cling to the old customs despite modern changes.

seed.explanation_ar: يتشبث أو يمسك في حاجة جامد وميسيبهاش، أو يلزق في حاجة.
seed.mnemonic: نفس الفكرة: 'Cling' يعني يلزق زي 'Link'.
seed.usage_note: Can be physical (cling to a rope) or emotional (cling to hope).

seed.definition_en: Passed from parents to children via genes.

examples.A1: Blue eyes are common in his family.
examples.A2: The king's title is hereditary.
examples.B1: Diabetes can be hereditary.
examples.B2: It is a hereditary condition passed down through generations.
examples.C1: The monarchy is a hereditary institution.
examples.C2: Scientists identified the hereditary defect in the gene.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة وراثية.. بتتنقل من الأب والأم للأولاد
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Heir' 'وريث'.. يعني حاجة بتتورث في العيلة
seed.usage_note: Used for diseases, titles, or physical traits.

seed.definition_en: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically based on practical considerations.

examples.A2: We need a pragmatic plan.
examples.B1: He is a pragmatic man who solves problems quickly.
examples.B2: We need to take a pragmatic approach to this issue.
examples.C1: The party adopted a more pragmatic stance on taxation.
examples.C2: Her pragmatic philosophy allowed her to navigate the complex political landscape.

seed.explanation_ar: عملي وواقعي، بيفكر في الحلول اللي تنفع تتنفذ وتجيب نتيجة مش بس نظريات وأحلام.
seed.mnemonic: شبه 'Program'.. الشخص الـ 'Pragmatic' ماشي بنظام وخطوات عملية زي الـ 'Program'.
seed.usage_note: Opposite of 'idealistic'. Often used in politics and business.

seed.definition_en: To form a theory without firm evidence; or to invest in high-risk ventures.

examples.A2: I can only guess.
examples.B1: We can speculate about why he left.
examples.B2: Analysts speculate that prices will rise.
examples.C1: He likes to speculate on the stock market.
examples.C2: Philosophers have long speculated about the nature of consciousness.

seed.explanation_ar: يخمن أو يتوقع أسباب حاجة من غير دليل قاطع، أو يغامر بفلوسه في البورصة.
seed.mnemonic: 'Spec' زي 'Spectacles' 'نظارة'.. كأنك بتبص وتحاول تشوف وتخمن المستقبل.
seed.usage_note: Often followed by 'on' or 'about'.

seed.definition_en: Opposite or contrary in direction, action, or sequence.

examples.A2: The converse is also true.
examples.B1: He holds the converse opinion to mine.
examples.B2: High speed increases risk; the converse effect is safety at low speeds.
examples.C1: However, the converse argument is equally valid.
examples.C2: In logic, if a proposition is true, its converse is not necessarily true.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة عكس حاجة تانية تمامًا، أو المقابل ليها.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Verse' يعني بيت شعر.. 'Converse' يعني البيت المقلوب أو العكس.
seed.usage_note: Distinguish from the verb 'converse' (to talk). As an adjective, stress is often on the second syllable, but noun 'converse' stress is on first.

seed.definition_en: In a way that requires immediate action or attention.

examples.A2: I need help urgently.
examples.B1: The doctor was called urgently.
examples.B2: We need to discuss this matter urgently.
examples.C1: Supplies are urgently needed in the disaster zone.
examples.C2: The committee urgently recommended a revision of the policy.

seed.explanation_ar: بشكل عاجل جداً ومحتاج تصرف فوراً، مفيش وقت للتأخير.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Urge' 'يُلح'.. الموقف بيُلِح عليك تتصرف 'Urgently'.
seed.usage_note: Used when something cannot wait.

seed.definition_en: A small printed piece of paper that entitles the holder to a discount or goods.

examples.A1: I have a paper for free food.
examples.A2: Use this voucher at the shop.
examples.B1: I received a gift voucher for my birthday.
examples.B2: This voucher is valid for three months.
examples.C1: The government issued travel vouchers to boost tourism.
examples.C2: Redeeming the voucher required adherence to strict terms and conditions.

seed.explanation_ar: ورقة أو كوبون بيديك الحق تاخد خصم أو تشتري حاجة ببلاش، زي كروت الهدايا.
seed.mnemonic: كلمة 'Voucher' شبه 'Vouch' 'يضمن'.. الورقة دي بتضمن لك الخصم.
seed.usage_note: Common in retail (gift voucher, discount voucher).

seed.definition_en: A castrated bull used as a draft animal.

examples.A2: The ox pulls the cart.
examples.B1: Farmers use oxen to plow fields.
examples.B2: The ox is a symbol of strength.
examples.C1: They roasted a whole ox for the feast.
examples.C2: The yoke was heavy on the neck of the ox.

seed.explanation_ar: الثور اللي بيستخدموه في الحقل لجر المحراث.
seed.mnemonic: حيوان قوي بيجر المحراث.. كلمة قصيرة 'Ox' بس بتوصف حيوان ضخم.
seed.usage_note: Plural is 'oxen'. Used for labor, unlike a regular bull.

seed.definition_en: To examine methodically and in detail the constitution or structure of something.

examples.A2: He analyzed the problem.
examples.B1: Scientists analyze the results of the experiment.
examples.B2: We need to analyze the market trends.
examples.C1: The software analyses text for sentiment.
examples.C2: She analyzed the poem's meter and rhyme scheme.

seed.explanation_ar: إنك تحلل حاجة وتفصصها عشان تفهمها كويس، زي تحليل البيانات أو تحليل الدم.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Analysis' 'تحليل'.. يعني بتعمل 'Analyse'.
seed.usage_note: British spelling is 'analyse'; American is 'analyze'.

seed.definition_en: Belonging naturally to something; essential.

examples.A2: It is an intrinsic part of the plan.
examples.B1: Trust is intrinsic to a good friendship.
examples.B2: The intrinsic value of the coin is low, but it is rare.
examples.C1: Maths is an intrinsic part of the school curriculum.
examples.C2: Freedom of speech is intrinsic to a democratic society.

seed.explanation_ar: حاجة أساسية وموجودة في طبيعة الشيء نفسه، مش مضافة عليه من بره، زي قيمة الدهب هي فيه هو.
seed.mnemonic: أولها 'In' 'داخل'.. الـ 'Intrinsic' هي القيمة اللي 'In' جوه الشيء نفسه مش جاية من بره.
seed.usage_note: Often followed by 'to' (intrinsic to human nature). Opposed to 'extrinsic'.

seed.definition_en: A principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

examples.A2: We have a strict criterion for entry.
examples.B1: The main criterion is value for money.
examples.B2: Academic ability is not the only criterion for admission.
examples.C1: The criteria for selection are very strict.
examples.C2: Validity is the most important criterion for this scientific test.

seed.explanation_ar: معيار أو مقياس بنحكم بيه على حاجة إذا كانت كويسة ولا لأ.
seed.mnemonic: تشبه 'Critic' 'ناقد'.. الناقد بيحكم بناءً على 'Criterion' 'معيار' معين.
seed.usage_note: Plural is 'criteria'. 'Criteria' is often incorrectly used as a singular.

seed.definition_en: A protein produced in the blood to fight diseases and foreign substances.

examples.A2: Antibodies help us stay healthy.
examples.B1: The vaccine helps your body make antibodies.
examples.B2: Tests showed a high level of antibodies in her blood.
examples.C1: The virus mutates to escape antibody detection.
examples.C2: Monoclonal antibody therapy is used for certain cancers.

seed.explanation_ar: مادة 'بروتين' جسمك بيفرزها عشان تحارب الأمراض والبكتيريا اللي بتهاجمك.
seed.mnemonic: 'Anti' يعني ضد.. و 'Body' يعني جسم.. هو جسم صغير 'Anti' 'ضد' الأمراض.
seed.usage_note: Key term in immunology and medicine.

seed.definition_en: To feel or show great joy or delight.

examples.A2: They smiled with joy.
examples.B1: Everyone rejoiced at the good news.
examples.B2: The whole country rejoiced when the war ended.
examples.C1: I rejoice to see you looking so well.
examples.C2: We rejoice in the triumph of truth over falsehood.

seed.explanation_ar: إنك تفرح جداً وتبتهج بحاجة حلوة حصلت.
seed.mnemonic: 'Re' + 'Joy' 'فرحة'.. 'Rejoice' يعني تعيش الـ 'Joy' 'الفرحة'.
seed.usage_note: Often used in literary or religious contexts.

seed.definition_en: To become smaller, weaker, or less important.

examples.A2: The pain started to go away.
examples.B1: Our supplies are diminishing rapidly.
examples.B2: His influence in the company began to diminish.
examples.C1: Don't let anyone diminish your achievements.
examples.C2: The gravitational pull diminishes as you move away from the planet.

seed.explanation_ar: يقلل أو يتضاءل، يعني الحاجة تصغر أو تضعف تدريجياً.
seed.mnemonic: فيها كلمة 'Mini' يعني صغير.. 'Diminish' يعني تخلي الحاجة 'Mini' 'تصغر'.
seed.usage_note: Can be physical (light diminishing) or abstract (hope diminishing).

seed.definition_en: Be enough or adequate.

examples.A2: One slice of pizza will suffice for me.
examples.B1: A simple 'yes' will suffice.
examples.B2: I think this amount should suffice for our needs.
examples.C1: Suffice it to say, the project was a failure.
examples.C2: Mere apologies will not suffice to repair the damage done.

seed.explanation_ar: إن الحاجة تكون كفاية وتأدي الغرض المطلوب من غير زيادة.
seed.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Sufficient' كافي.. وكلمة 'Safe'.. لما يكون معك اللي 'Suffice' بتبقى 'Safe'.
seed.usage_note: Formal way of saying 'be enough'.

seed.definition_en: Lower in rank or position.

examples.A2: She works under him.
examples.B1: A soldier is subordinate to an officer.
examples.B2: The needs of the individual are subordinate to the group.
examples.C1: He felt comfortable in a subordinate role.
examples.C2: All other considerations were subordinate to the main goal.

seed.explanation_ar: يعني حد رتبته أقل أو شغال تحت حد تاني.. تابع ليه
seed.mnemonic: 'Sub' يعني تحت 'زي Submarine'.. يبقى هو في رتبة أقل
seed.usage_note: As a noun, it means 'an employee'. As a verb (pronounced -ate), it means 'to treat as less important'.

seed.definition_en: Awkward in movement or in handling things.

examples.A2: I am very clumsy today.
examples.B1: He made a clumsy attempt to catch the ball.
examples.B2: The waiter was clumsy and spilled the wine.
examples.C1: It was a clumsy apology that made things worse.
examples.C2: The bulky equipment made the divers feel clumsy underwater.

seed.explanation_ar: يعني حركته تقيلة وبيوقع الحاجات.. مش رشيق
seed.mnemonic: الشخص الـ 'Clumsy' بيعمل 'Clumps' 'كوارث' وهو ماشي وبيكسر الحاجة
seed.usage_note: Can describe a person or an action (e.g., a clumsy apology).

seed.definition_en: Having assets in excess of liabilities; able to pay one's debts. Also, able to dissolve other substances.

examples.A2: Paint thinner is a strong solvent.
examples.B1: Use a solvent to clean the brush.
examples.B2: The company remained solvent despite the crisis.
examples.C1: Banks must ensure they remain solvent to protect depositors.
examples.C2: Organic solvents are often used in chemical synthesis.

seed.explanation_ar: معناها إن معاك فلوس تكفي تسدد ديونك 'موسر'. وفي الكيمياء معناها المادة اللي بتدوب غيرها 'مُذيب'.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Solve'. لو إنت 'Solvent' مادياً، تقدر تحل 'Solve' مشاكل ديونك.
seed.usage_note: Context determines meaning: Financial (solvent company) vs Chemical (solvent liquid).

seed.definition_en: In every case or on every occasion; always.

examples.A2: It happens every time. (Simpler equivalent)
examples.B1: The train is consistently late.
examples.B2: She invariably forgets her keys when she leaves.
examples.C1: Invariably, the most difficult questions are asked at the end.
examples.C2: Such policies invariably lead to economic stagnation.

seed.explanation_ar: كلمة معناها إن الحاجة دي بتحصل علطول في كل مرة، من غير أي تغيير أو استثناء.
seed.mnemonic: جاية من 'Vary' يختلف.. و 'In' للنفي.. يعني 'Invariably' حاجة مش بتختلف أبداً.
seed.usage_note: Stronger and more formal than 'always'. Implies a pattern that never changes.

seed.definition_en: To move from one region or habitat to another.

examples.A2: Some birds migrate in winter.
examples.B1: My grandparents migrated to America.
examples.B2: Thousands of workers migrate to the city for jobs.
examples.C1: We need to migrate the data to a new server.
examples.C2: The tribe migrated across the continent over centuries.

seed.explanation_ar: يعني يسيب بلده أو مكانه ويروح مكان تاني.. زي الطيور أو الناس
seed.mnemonic: الطيور بتعمل 'Migration' يعني هجرة.. بتسيب مكان وتروح مكان
seed.usage_note: Used for animals (seasonal) and people (permanent/work).[[1](https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fvertexaisearch.cloud.google.com%2Fgrounding-api-redirect%2FAUZIYQGoPmLP_eb5Lpd9On7eto4jDMy-T1V97FxYrZAaBSbw16zw0MDydhu4wgcR31Bf6epBFjwUUKUQhP-w12QuHmhLQmaMZMl7aT1Vy4ZpXlyHhIwIcakgymSLFYyhp_LFkUwh)][[2](https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fvertexaisearch.cloud.google.com%2Fgrounding-api-redirect%2FAUZIYQGycnFO2hpO9taHPLm9wZJhQ3D2Zf7d9TC7goQmnynR3JVJjHjEfhD0ThN7AHIYIyuKPt1wxgOTBc1h826AtmrIBHfp8PwbLhR3AGPwSmDYOOJg7XBqvuvNBc-A6dKJNvAhUOzCeDOnhcUXKBO8ghJ5nd_XUbyLnIhjIUgD3Ybgc-1FJroO-1tz3IaGdryHIgykW_p3mES1TaA0P0og6Q-AQsWjhziru_NsJNRFErjorwzAeQy45Q%3D%3D)][[3](https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fvertexaisearch.cloud.google.com%2Fgrounding-api-redirect%2FAUZIYQF2vg-mCSnrt38pt_esVJ0W1rLbRfW4q1Am89d7b_rJRpfgEWf05DRjCZG_2bXVQFnRLNr9E4fP-JOulsw1qkJrGon17TPwIbc5dE8UWZ-1TvjXqnvWYGAL-HQqBrP7Mh0naTaiBcyNW63fxcFjeAl8nHKxPE82IS6-ffchyoii1qN3oRz1gxAFxICISEQ0GWKmwwKUoQ%3D%3D)][[4](https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fvertexaisearch.cloud.google.com%2Fgrounding-api-redirect%2FAUZIYQFY9QExsKay0WReAdF1SZAqh_m6itrak9q7pL3LDuhgq0y_VUvScE-TrJ_00QJBP_obhJCXk4M8BTsgkJQAtJKfcwKcaJCl_c1TgnfXE8YHJxCIUbrI6VaCw_WulCSRNjH5KktNXPcN--8cDuzEvQxZfO3wScuNIPdvsGp7UVcj3-mVNvnnpkNghsCVVA%3D%3D)][[5](https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fvertexaisearch.cloud.google.com%2Fgrounding-api-redirect%2FAUZIYQGW2DsgczArhkmo65pYZGD0OObG5yJgxoACpm6V5v3K8OmQ4sFtbfPPQThdCU03S1wgddEY0A318BTIIvDOcSf41uDnltnkG-y6q4lUI8Uo1EN0LAfVnrufZn_-vDzoxr6aSJOlRIaBJRAN1GRIISygjMkjwP0kZrdb1ZcvRsUQ1nX3HC2PAzOuNkoacefH09GZCRqLG_WKazyUdmsV94do0VcFvkqM7RswdqX0AX57E1UkBS20lE3shKEbLmwUHib3pnpenQ%3D%3D)][[6](https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=https%3A%2F%2Fvertexaisearch.cloud.google.com%2Fgrounding-api-redirect%2FAUZIYQGrQSpI-imaWFJxhHKSTUhbbbmFz4P9_gBcJI0ub3GOmjomy1ib_cC3fw7Ud6A1sT54FEvfoNEY1BpW6_6DCq_wVBCwF0WvCzGKOCdtJtJBY8q5gKVdYXxG4BnrvexQs4qDqf3R675zkb_QCobTxm0O5yMiv67XLvKHKP0OZWok4q5c)][[7](https://www.google.com/url?sa=E&q=
